title: Senior SEO Specialist
description:
Job Overview



We are seeking a results-driven Senior SEO Specialist with strong expertise in search engine optimization, keyword strategy, and digital growth. The ideal candidate will be responsible for improving website rankings, increasing organic traffic, and optimizing overall search performance through effective SEO strategies.



The successful candidate should have hands-on experience in keyword research, technical SEO, on-page and off-page optimization, website analytics, and performance tracking. A creative eye for improving websites, catalogs, and marketing materials is highly preferred.



Key Responsibilities

Develop and implement effective SEO strategies to improve search rankings and visibility

Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and identify growth opportunities

Optimize website content, meta tags, images, and site structure for SEO

Execute on-page, off-page, and technical SEO, including link-building strategies

Monitor website performance using Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Moz, Screaming Frog, or similar tools

Analyze website traffic, rankings, and user behavior to provide actionable recommendations

Collaborate with developers and designers to improve website performance and technical SEO

Support content creation by ensuring SEO best practices are followed

Manage local SEO initiatives

Assist with Google Ads and
 Ads when needed

Stay up to date with Google's algorithm updates, SEO trends, and best practices

Recommend improvements for websites, catalogs, and other marketing materials



Requirements

5+ years of proven SEO experience

Strong knowledge of on-page, off-page, and technical SEO

Experience using Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Moz, Screaming Frog, or similar SEO tools

Experience with WordPress, Shopify, or other CMS platforms

Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and time management skills

Ability to work independently in a remote environment and meet deadlines

Willing to work US Eastern Time (8:30 AM–5:30 PM, Monday–Friday) with a 1-hour lunch break

Willing to use remote desktop software and time-tracking tools



Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Digital Media, Business, or a related field

Google Analytics, Google Ads, or SEO certifications

Experience in B2B, e-commerce, or SaaS

Basic knowledge of Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva



Compensation

35,000–100,000 pesos per month, depending on qualifications and experience. Salary is based on the USD to PHP exchange rate as of July 2026.



How to Apply



Please apply only if you meet the required qualifications listed above. Applications that do not meet the required qualifications will not be considered.



Please submit the following:

Resume (PDF or Microsoft Word format only)

Voice recording sample (English)

Send a link to your internet speed test results from Speedtest.net.

s – guiding them through travel options, bookings, and changes.

 ????? Technical Requirements:

Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5

4GB+ RAM (8GB preferred)

Windows OS / Mac OS

Sound Card, Speakers (optional)

Min 15” Monitor, preferably 2

A quality virus and spyware protection and activated firewall

Minimum of 50 mbps upload and download 

Stable wired broadband (no satellite or wireless). Broadband internet connection (DSL or cable) Note: Satellite, Dial-Up or wireless is not allowed. You will be required to test the connection

Chrome browser, sound card, speakers, 15" monitor (2 preferred).

Backup power solution (generator or equivalent) in case of outages. 



????? Bonus Points If You Have:

Experience with Odysseus software

Previous work in the cruise or travel sector

A passion for sales and client happiness

title: Expert Facebook Ad Video Editor — AI Voiceover (ElevenLabs) Experienced Only
description:
We’re looking for a highly skilled video ad editor to produce high-converting
/Meta ads, with Instagram and TikTok experience as a strong plus. This is not an entry-level role — if you don’t have proven experience editing paid social ads with portfolio proof, please do not apply.



Role Overview

You will take raw footage, stock clips, and AI-generated assets and turn them into scroll-stopping
 ads with sharp pacing, clean cuts, and strong hooks within the first 3 seconds. You’ll generate and sync AI voiceovers using ElevenLabs, matching tone, emotion, and rhythm to the visuals. Expect ongoing work producing multiple ad variations, cutdowns, and retargeting versions every week.



What You’ll Do

Edit short-form performance ads specifically for Meta 
 & Instagram), with TikTok as a plus.

Turn raw footage, stock/b-roll, and AI assets into polished, high-converting ad creatives.

Generate and sync AI voiceovers in ElevenLabs, choosing the right voice, emotion, and pacing for each script.

Add captions/subtitles, hooks, transitions, sound effects, and optimized pacing for paid social.

Produce multiple variations, cutdowns, and retargeting versions based on performance and feedback.

Follow creative briefs and direction closely while maintaining consistent quality and speed.



Required Skills & Experience

This is a performance-editing role, not a generic video editor position.

You must:

Have proven experience editing e-commerce ads specifically for Meta/Facebook (not just organic or long-form content).

Be confident with clipping, pacing, and timing for paid social ads — especially strong hooks within the first 3 seconds and high retention through the first 30 seconds.

Have hands-on experience with ElevenLabs for AI voiceover generation (voice selection, emotion tuning, and clean audio output).

Be highly proficient in CapCut Pro, Premiere Pro, or After Effects.

Be comfortable with captions/subtitles, sound design, b-roll layering, and basic motion graphics.

Have a strong understanding of what actually performs inside Meta Ads Manager (creatives, hooks, formats that drive results).

Have experience with short-form ad formats: UGC-style ads, voiceover ads, and product/demo ads.

Be able to meet daily deadlines, work independently, and communicate clearly in English.

Reliable internet, a capable editing setup, and the ability to handle ongoing work are non-negotiable.



Application Requirements (Strict)

To be considered, your proposal must include all of the following:

Direct links to previous
/Meta ads you have personally edited (not team projects, not generic reels).

Names of past clients or brands you’ve worked with, and case studies or results if available.

A short note on your editing workflow:

Software you use

How you approach hooks, pacing, and retention

How you integrate ElevenLabs voiceovers into your edits

Applications without work samples or without clear
/Meta ad experience will be rejected immediately. Do not apply if you are not specialized in paid social ad editing.



Trial Period (Paid)

Before moving to full-time, there will be a paid 2-week trial to evaluate:

Skill level and creative quality

Speed and consistency

Ability to follow directions and implement feedback

Trial terms:

Pay during trial: 10 USD per completed video/ad

Training, examples, and feedback will be provided

Only candidates who pass the trial will be considered for the full-time role



Full-Time Role Details (After Trial)

Weekends off (Saturday & Sunday)

Scripts are sent every weekday

Videos must be completed and delivered before the following day

Task-based work (no fixed hours, but daily deliverables are required)

Payment: 212 USD per week, paid every Sunday

Performance bonus: 150 USD for any “winning ad” that performs well in paid campaigns

This is a long-term, stable role for the right editor.



Responsibilities

Edit short-form voiceover ads for Meta 
 & Instagram), with TikTok as a plus.

Sync visuals tightly to ElevenLabs-generated voiceovers (access will be provided).

Use provided b-roll, product assets, and custom b-roll where needed.

Add attention-grabbing hooks, captions, transitions, and sound design optimized for paid social.

Follow creative briefs, brand guidelines, and iterative feedback closely.

Maintain consistent quality while hitting fast turnarounds.



Who This Role Is For

This role is for someone who:

Edits for performance and conversions first, not just aesthetics.

Understands hooks, pacing, and retention in a paid social context.

Wants a stable, long-term position with predictable weekly work.

Is motivated by performance-based bonuses and “winning ads.”

Can grow with the brand and contribute ideas to improve creatives over time

title: Internal Finance Manager / Senior Management Accountant
description:
Internal Finance Manager / Senior Management Accountant

Full-Time | Work From Home | Australian Accounting Experience Required



About the Role



We are seeking a strong, commercially minded and highly organised Internal Finance Manager / Senior Management Accountant to take ownership of the internal finance function for a growing Australian group of businesses.

This is a hands-on, all-rounder accounting role. You will be responsible for the complete finance cycle — from day-to-day transactions and reconciliations through to month-end close, management reporting, budgeting, cash flow forecasting, job costing, profitability analysis and KPI reporting.



You will also take ownership of important group financial administration, including insurance, licences and other renewals, and provide confidential financial support to the Founder.



This is not a purely transactional bookkeeping role, nor is it a position for someone who only reviews work prepared by others.



We need someone who can personally get into the detail, make sure the numbers are right, analyse what they mean and give management clear financial visibility.



You will work closely with the Founder and management team and play an important role in improving profitability, cash flow, financial controls and decision-making across the Group.



Key Responsibilities



1. Day-to-Day Accounting & Finance



Take ownership of the day-to-day internal accounting function across multiple entities, including:

• Bank and credit card reconciliations

• Accounts payable and accounts receivable oversight

• Payroll and payroll-related reconciliations

• Intercompany transactions and reconciliations

• Balance sheet reconciliations

• Fixed asset and accounting schedules

• Correct transaction coding and supporting documentation

• Investigation and correction of accounting discrepancies

• Maintenance of accurate and up-to-date financial records

• Identification of unusual transactions, errors and control weaknesses



You will be expected to remain hands-on and capable of completing detailed accounting work yourself when required.



2. Month-End Closing & Management Accounts



Take full ownership of the month-end process, including:

• Month-end journals

• Accruals and prepayments

• Payroll reconciliations

• Balance sheet reconciliations

• Intercompany reconciliations

• Revenue and expense cut-off

• Review of P&L and balance sheet

• Investigation of unusual movements

• Preparation of management accounts

• Month-end management commentary

• Ensuring reporting is completed accurately and on time



The successful candidate should be capable of independently driving month-end close without needing to be reminded of each task.



3. Budgeting, Forecasting & Cash Flow

• Prepare and maintain annual budgets

• Maintain rolling forecasts

• Prepare and maintain a rolling cash flow forecast

• Monitor actual results against budget

• Analyse and explain material variances

• Identify upcoming cash requirements and potential cash flow risks

• Monitor working capital

• Provide management with early warning of potential financial issues

• Recommend practical actions based on financial results



4. Job Costing & Profitability Analysis



A major responsibility of this role is to establish strong visibility over profitability across the Group.

This includes:

• Gross profit by client

• Gross profit by employee

• Gross profit by team/division

• Gross profit by business entity

• Client revenue versus labour cost

• Actual hours/cost versus client budget

• Employee utilisation and productivity

• Revenue and cost per employee

• Identification of underperforming clients, jobs or service areas

• Identification of scope creep and cost overruns

• Development and continuous improvement of job costing methodologies

• Recommendations to improve margins and operational efficiency



The successful candidate must be able to go beyond producing numbers and explain what the numbers mean, why performance has changed and what management should investigate or change.



5. KPI Dashboard & Performance Reporting



Take ownership of the financial KPI and management reporting framework across the Group.

Responsibilities include:

• Develop and maintain management KPI dashboards

• Ensure KPI data is accurate, reconciled and supported by reliable source data

• Monitor revenue, gross profit and GP%

• Monitor profitability by client, employee, team and business entity

• Monitor client budget versus actual hours/cost

• Monitor employee utilisation and productivity

• Track budget versus actual performance

• Monitor cash flow and working capital

• Monitor accounts receivable and overdue debts

• Maintain historical KPI trends

• Identify adverse trends and exceptions requiring management attention

• Investigate the underlying causes of financial underperformance

• Provide concise management commentary and recommendations

• Continuously improve and automate KPI reporting where practical



The objective is to give management timely, accurate and actionable visibility over the financial health and performance of the Group.



This position is expected to highlight problems proactively rather than simply produce reports.



6. Group Finance & Corporate Administration



Take ownership of important recurring financial and administrative obligations, including:

• Insurance renewals

• Professional and business licence renewals

• Registrations and other recurring compliance renewals

• Finance and loan documentation

• Subscription and contract renewals

• Maintaining a centralised renewal and compliance calendar

• Ensuring deadlines are identified well in advance

• Obtaining information and quotations where required

• Maintaining appropriate supporting documentation

• Escalating matters requiring management approval



An important expectation of this position is that key financial and administrative obligations are proactively managed without relying on the Founder to remember or continually follow them up.



7. Founder / Personal Finance Support



Provide highly confidential financial and administrative support to the Founder, including:

• Personal cash flow and financial reporting

• Investment and property-related accounting records

• Loan and finance schedules

• Personal financial administration

• Coordination of information required for tax and financial planning

• Maintaining accurate records across personal and business financial matters



A very high level of confidentiality, integrity and discretion is essential.



8. Systems, Automation & Continuous Improvement

• Improve finance processes, controls and reporting systems

• Reduce unnecessary manual work

• Identify opportunities for automation

• Use technology and AI appropriately to improve finance efficiency

• Ensure automated reports and processes remain accurate and properly controlled

• Document important finance processes

• Build scalable finance systems capable of supporting continued Group growth



What We Are Looking For



The ideal candidate is an experienced all-rounder accountant who can work confidently from detailed transactions through to management-level financial analysis.



You should have:

• Degree in Accounting, Finance or equivalent

• CPA/CA qualification or progress towards qualification highly regarded

• Strong Australian accounting experience

• Strong management accounting experience

• Demonstrated experience independently completing month-end close

• Budgeting and cash flow forecasting experience

• Strong job costing and profitability analysis skills

• Advanced Excel skills

• Strong Xero experience

• Excellent reconciliation and problem-solving skills

• Experience working across multiple entities

• Strong attention to detail

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Excellent organisational and deadline-management skills

• High level of confidentiality and professional judgement

• Ability to work independently with limited supervision



The Person We Want



We are looking for someone who:

• Takes ownership rather than waiting for instructions

• Is naturally organised and follows matters through to completion

• Notices when numbers do not make sense and investigates why

• Can move comfortably between detailed accounting and commercial analysis

• Is willing to remain hands-on

• Can prioritise effectively in a fast-moving environment

• Builds systems and controls rather than repeatedly fixing the same problems

• Is proactive about upcoming deadlines and financial risks

• Communicates issues early rather than waiting until they become urgent

• Can respectfully challenge numbers, assumptions and processes

• Looks continuously for opportunities to automate and improve finance processes

• Understands that good internal finance is not simply about producing accounts — it is about giving management visibility, control and actionable information



Key Measures of Success



Success in this position will include:

• Accurate and timely month-end closing

• Reliable management accounts

• Fully reconciled balance sheet accounts

• Reliable budget versus actual reporting

• Accurate and regularly maintained cash flow forecasting

• Clear visibility of gross profit by client, employee, team and business area

• Reliable KPI dashboards

• Early identification and escalation of financial risks

• Strong accounts receivable and working capital visibility

• No missed insurance, licence or important renewal deadlines

• Improved finance processes, controls and automation

• Reduced reliance on the Founder for routine finance administration and follow-up



The Opportunity



This is an opportunity to take genuine ownership of the internal finance function of a growing Australian business group.

For the right person, the position has significant potential to develop into a broader finance leadership role as the Group continues to grow.

title: Administrative Assistant

We are a fast-growing exterior home services company in the U.S. We are looking for a dependable, proactive, and organized Administrative Assistant to support our daily operations.



This is a long-term position for someone who wants to grow with our company and become a valuable part of our team.

Responsibilities

Answer and manage inbound customer calls

, and text

Provide friendly and professional customer service

Schedule customer appointments and estimates

Confirm upcoming appointments

Reschedule appointments when necessary

Make outbound follow-up calls

Follow up with leads and customers

Manage and maintain the company calendar

Communicate appointment details with our team

Update customer information and job details in our CRM

Enter data accurately and keep records organized

Follow up on missed calls and messages

Track daily tasks and make sure nothing is overlooked

Organize digital files and documents

Use AI tools to improve productivity and complete administrative tasks

ChatGPT

AI productivity tools

Google Workspace

Microsoft Office

CRM systems

Calendar and scheduling software

Online communication platforms

You do not need to be an AI expert. We want someone who is willing to learn and use new technology.

The ideal candidate is:



Dependable and reliable

Proactive and self-motivated

Organized and detail-oriented

Professional and friendly

Confident communicating with customers

Comfortable answering phone calls

Excellent in written and spoken English

Able to multitask and prioritize

A quick learner

Comfortable using computers and online software

Able to work independently

Good at solving problems

Someone who takes ownership of their responsibilities

Looking for a stable, long-term position

Important

We are not looking for someone who needs constant supervision.



We want someone who can take a task, understand what needs to be done, and follow through.



If a customer doesn't confirm an appointment, you follow up.



If a call is missed, you make sure it is returned.



If you notice a scheduling issue, you communicate it.



We want someone who takes initiative and helps keep our daily operations running smoothly.



Requirements

Previous Administrative Assistant or Virtual Assistant experience preferred

Customer service experience preferred

Experience handling phone calls

Excellent English communication skills

Strong organizational skills

Good computer skills

Comfortable learning new software

Reliable high-speed internet

Reliable computer/laptop

Quiet and professional workspace

Ability to work during U.S. business hours

Strong attention to detail

Commitment to a long-term working relationship

Preferred Experience

Experience in any of these areas is a plus:



Administrative Assistant

Virtual Assistant

Customer Service

Appointment Setting

Scheduling

Call Center

CRM Management

Lead Follow-Up

Home Services

Exterior Services

Painting

Roofing

Construction

Remodeling

AI Tools

ChatGPT

What We Offer

Long-term, stable employment

Competitive compensation based on experience

Training and onboarding

Supportive team environment

Opportunity to grow with a rapidly expanding company

Opportunities for increased responsibility

Opportunity to learn and use modern AI tools and technology

How to Apply

Please include the following in your application:



Your resume

A brief introduction about yourself

Your previous administrative/customer service experience

Your experience handling inbound calls and scheduling

The AI tools you currently use

Your expected monthly salary

Your availability and preferred working hours

Application Question

Please answer this question at the beginning of your application:



"What would you do if you had several customer calls, appointments to confirm, and other administrative tasks at the same time? How would you prioritize your work?"



Applications that do not answer the question may not be considered.



We are looking for a dependable, proactive, organized, and motivated person who wants to build a long-term relationship with our growing company.



If you are a self-starter who enjoys helping customers and keeping things organized, we want to hear from you!

title: Level 1.5 Service Desk Technician
description:
Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Service Desk Technician with strong technical troubleshooting and problem-solving skills to support a diverse portfolio of business clients.



This is more than a traditional L1 helpdesk role. We operate in complex IT environments involving Microsoft 365, enterprise applications, ERP systems, networking, endpoints, and other business-critical technologies.



The ideal candidate is resourceful, analytical, and comfortable working independently. You should be able to investigate issues beyond basic troubleshooting procedures, effectively use KBs and SOPs, and determine the appropriate solution or escalation path.



What You'll Do

• Provide L1/L2 technical support through phone,
, and ticketing systems.

• Troubleshoot and resolve issues involving Windows/macOS, Microsoft 365, endpoints, networking, identity management, and business applications.

• Support applications such as ERP, CRM, accounting, HR, engineering, and other business systems.

• Investigate unfamiliar or complex technical issues using KBs, SOPs, documentation, and other available resources.

• Manage user accounts, permissions, onboarding/offboarding, and application access.

• Monitor and respond to RMM alerts and proactively address potential issues.

• Maintain accurate ticket documentation, troubleshooting notes, and resolution details.

• Escalate issues appropriately while providing complete troubleshooting information and maintaining ownership through resolution.

• Work across multiple client environments while meeting SLA and quality expectations.



What We're Looking For

• 3+ years of Service Desk/Help Desk experience; MSP experience strongly preferred.

• Experience providing support beyond basic password resets, account administration, and standardized L1 procedures.

• Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to independently investigate issues and identify appropriate next steps.

• Comfortable learning and supporting unfamiliar applications and technologies.

• Strong experience with Microsoft 365, Active Directory/Entra ID, Windows, networking, and endpoint support.

• Experience with RMM and PSA/ticketing platforms.

• Experience with AutoCAD.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Excellent documentation, time management, and multitasking skills.

• Self-directed and accountable in a remote work environment.



Preferred Experience

• Enterprise or complex IT environments

title: Sales Associate - Demo Setter
description:
Sales Associate - Demo Setter



POSITION IDENTIFICATION

Department Sales

Working Title Sales Demo Setter - Sales Associate

Assignment Category Full-Time Remote (Independent Contractor)

Job Classification Outbound Lead Generation / Sales Support

Reports To Rameil Eaywazi / Kevin Kahn



POSITION SUMMARY



The Sales Demo Setter is responsible for generating qualified leads and booking product-demo

meetings with prospective clients, primarily U.S. law firms. This position focuses on outbound

prospecting through job sites, phone calls,
s, and other approved outreach channels. Demo

Setters identify companies actively hiring, initiate contact, and secure demo appointments for the

Sales Team. They maintain accurate CRM records, support follow-ups, and ensure smooth

coordination with Sales Leads to convert opportunities into signed clients.



DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES



A. Lead Generation and Outreach

a. Research and identify prospective clients (law firms currently hiring) via online job boards and

professional sites.

b. Contact prospects through cold calls, personalized
s, and follow-up sequences.

c. Use provided templates, scripts, and tools to maximize outreach performance.



B. Demo Scheduling and Coordination

a. Book demo appointments between prospects and Sales Representatives.

b. Confirm prospect attendance and ensure all meeting details are correctly logged in the CRM.

c. Coordinate with the Sales Team regarding schedules, updates, and lead status.



C. CRM Management and Reporting

a. Maintain clean, accurate data within HubSpot or the assigned CRM.

b. Update lead status and activities daily for transparent pipeline visibility.

c. Provide regular reports on leads generated, demos booked, and conversion metrics.



D. Follow-Up and Conversion Support

a. Monitor scheduled demos to ensure prospects attend and engage.

b. Track post-demo communications and assist in ensuring prospects move toward closing.

c. Ensure signed contracts are documented for commission eligibility.



E. Collaboration and Professional Development

a. Maintain consistent communication with Team Leads and Sales Managers.

b. Participate in team meetings, trainings, and performance reviews.

c. Stay updated on industry trends, sales strategies, and CRM best practices.



KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

1. Number of qualified leads generated monthly.

2. Number of demos successfully booked and held.

3. Accuracy and consistency of CRM data.

4. Response time to leads and internal communications.

5. Minimum of 100 calls and 100
s daily (50
s should be to new companies every

day)



CADENCE REPORT

1. Daily lead updates in CRM (HubSpot).

2. Weekly outreach performance report to Team Lead.

3. Weekly meeting with Sales Manager for pipeline review.

4. Monthly commission review based on booked and signed clients.

5. Quarterly performance assessment and goal alignment.



JOB SPECIFICATION



Educational Attainment : Bachelor’s degree preferred (business, marketing, communication, or related field). Equivalent experience accepted.

Related Work Experience : Minimum 2 years of experience in sales, customer service, or outbound lead generation roles.

Preferred Qualification : Prior experience with U.S. law firms or legal-industry clients is an advantage.

Proficiency : G Suite, HubSpot CRM, Slack, Zoom, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, job sites (Indeed, ZipRecruiter, etc.).

Required Skills Exceptional English communication skills (verbal and written); strong organizational and time-management skills; attention to detail; internet research proficiency; logical thinking and common sense; self-motivation and goal orientation.

Diversity and Complexity of Supervision:  Works under the general supervision of the Team Lead and Sales Manager with moderate autonomy.

Scope of Human Resources impact:  Individual contributor role with direct impact on sales pipeline and revenue generation.

Level and Nature of Internal Contacts :  Frequent interaction with Sales Team, Placement Department, and Operations Managers.

title: Amazon Operations Specialist - Listings, PPC & AI Images (Full-Time)
description:
PAY AND HOURS - READ THIS FIRST



I am putting this at the top instead of the bottom, because I would rather you stop reading now than after you have done a test task.



Rate: $2.50 - $3.00 USD per hour, depending on experience.



One-month trial: 4 hours a day, Monday to Friday (roughly $220 - $260 for the month)



After the trial: full-time, 8 hours a day, Monday to Friday (roughly $430 - $520 per month)



This is not a premium rate and I am not going to pretend otherwise. What it is, is stable, long-term, and honest about itself from the first line. If that number does not work for you, close this now with no hard feelings - you are not wrong to want more, and I would rather you told me at the start than three months in.



At the end of the trial month we both d
. You say whether you want to go full-time, I say whether I want you to. If either answer is no, we stop there with nothing owed either way.





WHAT THIS JOB ACTUALLY IS



Amazon private label operations, across multiple accounts and marketplaces (US, UK, CA, AU).



Day to day:



- Keyword research, then writing listings from it - title, bullets, description, backend search terms - inside Amazon's character and byte limits and inside Amazon's rules on what you may and may not claim

- Producing listing images with AI: main image, the seven-image gallery, A+ and Premium A+ modules

- Creating and managing Sponsored Products / Brands / Display campaigns, reading the reports, and changing bids and negatives because of what the data says

- Booking deals, setting up coupons, monitoring them

- Listing maintenance: suppressions, compliance flags, category and browse node issues, appeals and Plans of Action when they are needed



This is an operations job. AI is a tool inside it, not the point of it.





STRICT SOP COMPLIANCE - THE PART MOST PEOPLE UNDERESTIMATE



Almost everything here is done against a written SOP. Image dimensions, file naming, what may be claimed about a product, how a deal is booked, what goes in a calendar entry.



These are not style preferences. On our accounts a wrong character in a file name makes a bulk upload fail silently - the asset never goes live and nothing reports an error. An unsupported claim in a bullet can suppress a listing. A missing field in a calendar entry breaks an automated check downstream.



I need someone who reads the document, follows it exactly, and tells me when the document does not cover the situation - rather than guessing and carrying on. If following written process precisely bores you, this is the wrong job and we will both find that out in week two.





WHAT YOU MUST HAVE



- Two years or more of hands-on Amazon operations experience, inside Seller Central yourself, not producing assets for someone else to upload

- Listing creation from keyword research, with a real keyword tool (Helium 10, DataDive, Jungle Scout, SellerSprite - name yours)

- AI image production for listings, including A+ and main images

- PPC: you have built campaigns and changed them based on reports, not just watched someone else do it

- Written and spoken English good enough to read a compliance policy and write copy that sells

- Overlap with Australian business hours (Manila is 2 hours behind Sydney, so normal Philippine working hours are fine)



Nice to have, not required: video editing or AI video, Shopify, experience with health, beauty or personal care categories.





HOW TO APPLY



Put the word WOMBAT at the top of your application. I use it to see who reads to the end. Applications without it are not read.



Then answer these. Short answers are fine. Made-up answers are worse than short ones.



1. Which Amazon accounts or brands have you worked on? Give me one live ASIN or storefront link I can open.



2. How many years have you personally worked inside Seller Central? What do you do in there in a normal week?



3. What tool do you use for keyword research, and what do you do with the export once you have it?



4. Which AI tools do you use for listing images? Send me ONE image you made yourself, and tell me: what the first generation got wrong, what you changed, and how many attempts it took. The failed versions are more useful to me than the finished one.



5. In your experience, what is the most common way AI product images go wrong, and how do you catch it before it goes live?



6. Have you handled a suppressed listing, a policy warning, or a compliance appeal? Describe one - what was wrong, what you actually did in Seller Central, and how long it took.



7. Your rate, and when you could start.





BONUS QUESTION - this is the one I read first



Pick any product that is currently number one in its category on Amazon. Send me the link, and tell me five things you would change about its listing and why.



You are allowed to tell me it is already good and that there is nothing worth changing - if that is your honest read, say so and explain it. I am not testing whether you can find faults. I am testing whether you can look at a page and see what is actually driving it.





A FEW THINGS ABOUT HOW I WORK



I read every application properly and I reply to everyone, including no.



If I ask you to do a test task, it will be short - an hour or two of work, not a day of it.



I would rather you tell me you do not know something than guess. Asking questions before you start is a good sign, not a bad one.



Thanks for reading this far.

title: GoHighLevel system
description:
GoHighLevel Recruiting Automation Project Brief

Implementation Instructions for Selected GHL Automation Specialist

Project Overview

You have been selected to build First Family Trust's recruiting and interview automation system inside our existing GoHighLevel account. The hiring framework has already been designed. Your responsibility is to translate the approved process into a clean, functional, tested, and documented GoHighLevel system.

Primary objective: A candidate should move from application through screening, assessment, CEO review, paid trial, offer, and final hiring outcome with the CRM controlling pipeline stages, scheduling, communications, reminders, internal tasks, and handoffs.

1. Project Scope

•	Work inside our existing GoHighLevel account.

•	Do not modify unrelated existing workflows without approval.

•	Build the recruiting system using clear workflow names, folders, tags, custom fields, calendars, and pipeline stages.

•	Use our approved candidate communications and hiring process.

•	Ask for clarification before making a business-rule assumption that could affect candidates or existing systems.

•	Test all major paths before the project is considered complete.

2. Dedicated Interview Rooms

Coordinate/configure two dedicated recurring Zoom rooms and connect the appropriate links to the scheduling and communication workflows.

Room	Purpose

First Family Trust | Candidate Interview Room	Stage 1 recruiter screening

First Family Trust | Candidate Assessment Room	Stage 2 skills assessment

•	Do not use the CEO's Personal Meeting ID.

•	Stage 1 communications must populate the Stage 1 room link.

•	Stage 2 communications must populate the Assessment room link.

•	Account for rescheduling/cancellation so outdated reminders are not sent.

3. Build the Recruiting Pipeline

Create the pipeline: VA Recruiting Pipeline - 2026.

1. Application Received

2. Application Under Review

3. Interview Approved

4. Stage 1 Scheduled

5. Stage 1 Completed

6. Stage 2 Approved

7. Stage 2 Scheduled

8. CEO Interview

9. Paid Trial

10. Offer Pending

11. Hired

12. Future Consideration

13. Not Selected

4. Candidate Records & Custom Fields

Create standardized candidate fields sufficient to operate and report on the recruiting process.

•	Name,
, phone, location/time zone and application date

•	Resume/resume link and video introduction link

•	Current pipeline stage

•	Interview dates/times and assigned interviewer

•	Stage 1 score and recommendation

•	Stage 2 score and recommendation

•	CEO score/decision

•	Paid trial score

•	Strengths, concerns, red flags and technical/communication notes

•	Follow-up required

•	Next action and next-action due date

•	Final decision

Use controlled dropdowns where appropriate for recommendations, decisions, interviewer assignment, and other standardized values.

5. Interview Scheduling

•	Create/configure separate Stage 1 and Stage 2 interview calendars.

•	Prevent double booking.

•	Capture and correctly display candidate time zone.

•	Assign the correct interviewer.

•	Insert the correct Zoom room link.

•	Move/update the opportunity when the appointment is booked.

•	Create internal interviewer notification/task.

•	Handle reschedules, cancellations, and appointment-status changes correctly.

6. Candidate Communication Automations

Trigger / Status	Required Action

Interview Approved	Send approved interview acceptance
.

Stage 1 booked	Immediate confirmation with date, time, time zone, Zoom link, duration, and preparation instructions.

24 hours before Stage 1	Reminder.

2 hours before Stage 1	Reminder.

15 minutes before Stage 1	Reminder.

Stage 2 Approved	Send advancement / Stage 2 scheduling communication.

Stage 2 booked	Send assessment confirmation and correct Assessment Room link.

Stage 2 upcoming	Send configured reminders.

Future Consideration	Stop active interview sequence; send approved communication when applicable.

Not Selected	Send approved rejection communication and stop interview reminders.

Offer Pending	Trigger internal offer task and approved candidate communication.

Hired	Stop recruiting workflows and hand off to onboarding.

7. Internal Team Automations

•	Interview Approved -> scheduling task for Data Manager / Recruiting Coordinator.

•	Stage 1 Scheduled -> notify HR interviewer and create interview-prep task.

•	Stage 1 Completed -> create scorecard-completion task if score/recommendation is missing.

•	Stage 2 Approved -> scheduling task.

•	Stage 2 Scheduled -> notify Operations Manager and create assessment-prep task.

•	CEO Interview -> notify CEO/assistant with candidate details, prior scores/notes, and meeting information.

•	Paid Trial -> create trial setup tasks.

•	Offer Pending -> create offer preparation/follow-up tasks.

•	Not Selected or Future Consideration -> close obsolete tasks and stop active interview reminders.

8. Decision & Pipeline Logic

The system must support these outcomes without incorrect communications:

•	Advance

•	Hold

•	Decline

•	Reschedule

•	Cancel

•	No-show

•	Future Consideration

•	Paid Trial

•	Offer Pending

•	Hired

Example: once a candidate is declined, canceled, or moved out of an active interview stage, they must not continue receiving interview reminders.

9. Stage Handoffs

Stage 1 Handoff

•	Provide interviewer access to candidate record, resume/link, interview time, Zoom link, and score fields.

•	Allow interviewer to record score, notes, and Advance / Hold / Decline recommendation.

•	Advance triggers Stage 2 process; Hold does not a
 trigger advancement or rejection; Decline triggers Not Selected process.

Stage 2 Handoff

•	Operations Manager receives candidate details and assessment information.

•	Candidate receives correct assessment scheduling information and Zoom link.

•	Store Stage 2 score/recommendation and move passing candidates to CEO Interview.

CEO / Paid Trial Handoff

•	CEO receives finalist information, prior scores, strengths/concerns, and interview details.

•	CEO approval moves candidate to Paid Trial.

•	Paid Trial completion captures trial score/final decision.

•	Approved candidate moves to Offer Pending and then Hired.

•	Hired candidates leave recruiting workflows and enter onboarding handoff.

10. Recruiting Dashboard

Build a simple management view/dashboard showing at minimum:

•	Total applications

•	Under review

•	Interview approved

•	Stage 1 scheduled/completed/passed

•	Stage 2 candidates

•	CEO finalists

•	Paid trials

•	Hired

•	Upcoming interviews

•	Overdue follow-ups / next actions

Leadership should be able to understand the recruiting funnel without opening each individual candidate record.

11. QA & Testing Requirements

Before delivery, run test candidates through the system.

Test Path	Required

Application -> Interview -> Stage 2 -> CEO -> Paid Trial -> Offer -> Hired	Yes

Application -> Interview -> Not Selected	Yes

Hold	Yes

Reschedule	Yes

Cancellation	Yes

No-show	Yes

Future Consideration	Yes

•	Verify merge fields: name, date, time, time zone, Zoom link, interviewer, duration.

•	Verify duplicate-message prevention.

•	Verify reminders stop when no longer applicable.

•	Verify pipeline movements.

•	Verify internal notifications and tasks.

•	Verify appointment/reschedule/cancellation logic.

•	Verify no existing unrelated GHL automation is disrupted.

12. Documentation & Handoff

At project completion, provide a basic handoff explaining:

•	Pipeline and stages created

•	Custom fields created

•	Calendars configured

•	Workflows created

•	Workflow triggers and stop conditions

•	Tags or naming conventions used

•	How Stage 1 and Stage 2 scheduling works

•	How candidate decisions trigger next steps

•	How to edit candidate
/reminder templates

•	How to troubleshoot the most likely workflow issues

All workflows should be named and organized clearly enough that another GHL administrator can maintain the system later.

13. Definition of Done

The project is complete when a test candidate can move through the full First Family Trust recruiting process with correct pipeline stages, scheduling, Zoom links, candidate communications, reminders, internal tasks, score/decision capture, reporting, and final hiring outcome without the team manually rebuilding the process for each candidate.

Operating standard: Nobody gets lost in the pipeline, every next action is clear, and automation reduces administrative work without sacrificing accuracy.

14. Completion Checklist

☐ Recruiting pipeline created

☐ Candidate custom fields created

☐ Stage 1 calendar configured

☐ Stage 2 calendar configured

☐ Zoom links connected

☐ Acceptance workflow built

☐ Stage 1 confirmation/reminders built

☐ Stage 2 advancement/confirmation/reminders built

☐ Internal notifications/tasks built

☐ Scorecard follow-up logic built

☐ CEO handoff built

☐ Paid Trial / Offer Pending handoff built

☐ Not Selected / Future Consideration logic built

☐ Hired / onboarding handoff built

☐ Dashboard/reporting view built

☐ All required test paths passed

☐ System documented and handed off

title: HIGH-LEVEL YOUTUBE VIDEO EDITOR WANTED — ONGOING WORK
description:
I’m looking for a highly skilled YouTube video editor to work with me on an ongoing basis creating professional, highly engaging long-form YouTube content for my personal brand.



I’m not looking for basic cuts, captions or template-style editing.



I want someone who understands YouTube retention, storytelling, pacing and motion graphics and knows how to turn raw talking-head footage into a video that keeps people watching.



I’ll provide the raw footage, script and any specific direction needed. You’ll be responsible for bringing the video to life through the edit.



THE STYLE I'M LOOKING FOR



The content will mainly be around:



Money and finance

Investing and trading

Business

Mindset and self-development

Educational / documentary-style personal brand content



Most videos will be talking-head/scripted videos, but I want the editing to make them feel visually engaging throughout.



This means combining the main footage with B-roll, motion graphics, animations, visual examples, screenshots, charts, text and other creative elements rather than simply cutting between camera angles.



WHAT I NEED



You need to be VERY good at YouTube editing and understand what actually keeps viewers watching.



I'm looking for someone capable of:



Creating extremely engaging openings in the first 30–60 seconds

Strong pacing and removing unnecessary dead space

High-quality motion graphics and animations

Animated text and typography

Creative B-roll selection and placement

Visual storytelling that supports what I'm saying

Charts, graphs, numbers and financial concepts presented visually

Screenshots, websites and social media posts incorporated professionally

Pattern interrupts to maintain attention

Punch-ins, reframing and camera movement

Sound design and subtle sound effects

Music selection and audio mixing

Professional colour correction and grading

Clean transitions that don't feel overdone

Knowing when to make an edit visually intense and when to keep it simple

Creating a polished, premium final product



Most importantly, you need to understand viewer retention.



I don't want random effects added just for the sake of making the screen busy. Every B-roll clip, animation, graphic or transition should help tell the story, explain the point or keep the viewer engaged.



QUALITY REFERENCES



These are examples of the level and style of editing I'm looking for.



You do NOT need to copy these creators exactly. These are simply references so you understand the quality standard I'm expecting.



REFERENCE 1:





REFERENCE 2:





REFERENCE 3:





Please watch these before applying.



If you aren't confident you can produce work at or close to this standard, please don't apply.



ONGOING WORK



This is not a one-off project.



I'm building my YouTube channel seriously and want to find an editor I can work with consistently long-term.



There will be regular videos available for the right person, and potentially significantly more work as the channel grows.



You need to be:



Reliable

Responsive

Consistent

Able to follow direction

Creative enough to make editing decisions yourself

Capable of meeting agreed deadlines

Open to feedback and revisions



I'm looking for someone who can eventually understand my content and editing style well enough that I don't need to explain every little detail on every video.



TO APPLY



Please send me:



Your best 3–5 YouTube videos you've edited — only send your BEST work.

Examples that specifically demonstrate motion graphics, storytelling and high-retention editing.

Any finance, business, educational or personal-brand content you've edited.

Your usual turnaround time for a full YouTube video.

How many long-form videos you can realistically edit per week.

Your price per video and/or ongoing monthly rate.

What editing software you use.

Whether you personally complete the edits or work with a team.

A short explanation of how you approach viewer retention when editing a YouTube video.



IMPORTANT: Please don't send me a huge portfolio of average work.



I'd rather see 3 incredible videos than 30 average ones.



Please don't apply if you're still learning, mainly use templates, or only have basic editing experience.



I'm looking for a genuinely high-level YouTube editor who understands modern YouTube content and can help me build a premium channel over the long term.

title: Executive Operations Assistant – Systems, Property Management & Marketing
description:
I run multiple growing businesses and am looking for a highly capable, proactive Executive Operations Assistant who can become a genuine right hand to me.



This is not a task-based VA role.



I need someone who notices what needs attention, follows through without being chased, keeps deadlines moving, solves problems, and helps reduce the amount I personally need to remember.



I value intelligence, good judgment, reliability and results. If something is going off track, I want to know before the deadline is missed, not afterward.



This role starts part-time, but my goal is to grow it into a long-term, full-time position. The more responsibility you can confidently take off my plate, the more time I have to grow the businesses, which creates more opportunity for you as well.



What You’ll Help With



Your work will span several businesses and may include:



Executive and administrative support

Managing deadlines, follow-ups and outstanding items

Research and troubleshooting

Canva and social media support

Content scheduling and marketing coordination

Using AI and technology to make work more efficient

You are:



Extremely detail-oriented

Proactive rather than reactive

Excellent with follow-through

Reliable with deadlines

Comfortable respectfully following up with me when I am holding something up

Resourceful and willing to troubleshoot before asking for help

Able to prioritize independently

Comfortable with technology and learning new systems

Someone who thinks about the outcome, not just whether a task was checked off



I should not have to manage the person who is supposed to be helping manage me.



Experience & Skills



Experience in any combination of the following is valuable:



Executive Assistant / Executive VA

Operations or Project Coordination

Online Business Management

Property Management

Airbnb / Short-Term Rentals

Direct support to a founder, entrepreneur or small-business owner



Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills are essential.



Experience with tools such as Google Workspace, Canva, ChatGPT, Airtable, Zapier/Make, project-management software, CRM systems, Airbnb, VRBO, Buildium or similar platforms is an asset.



You do not need to know every platform. You do need to be confident figuring things out.



Schedule & Compensation

Remote

15–20 hours/week to start

$7–$9 CAD/hour depending on experience

Flexible hours after onboarding, with availability for time-sensitive matters

Goal to grow toward 20–25 hours and ultimately full-time



I am looking for someone who wants a long-term opportunity and can grow in responsibility as trust develops.



This Role Is Not for You If



This is probably not the right fit if you:



Need detailed daily instructions

Wait to be told every next step

Miss deadlines without warning

Need repeated reminders

Immediately bring problems back without attempting to solve them

Consider a task complete even when the intended result has not happened



How to Apply



Please do not send a generic cover letter.



Start your application with:



“I read the full posting.”



Then briefly answer:

3. What experience do you have with Airbnb, property management, spreadsheets, systems, automation or social media management?

5. Quick judgment test:

An Airbnb guest arriving today is missing check-in information, a contractor is overdue, you are waiting on my approval for something due tomorrow, and you have a non-urgent project due today.



What do you handle first? What do you handle yourself? What needs my attention? What gets postponed?



Also include your resume, availability.



One final example of the mindset I’m looking for:



If I ask you to review an Airbnb listing, I don’t just want you to complete the one thing I asked for. I want you to look at the listing as a whole, notice anything inaccurate, outdated, inconsistent or poorly presented, and either improve it or bring me a recommendation.

title: Customer Service & Administrative Virtual Assistant
description:
We are a growing service business looking for a dependable, professional, and highly organized Customer Service & Administrative Virtual Assistant to join our team.



The primary focus of this role is customer service and phone support. You will help answer incoming calls, follow up with customers, schedule appointments, respond to messages, and make sure our customers receive a friendly and professional experience.



When call volume is lower, you will also assist with data entry, reporting, CRM updates, administrative tasks, and basic social media support.



We are looking for someone who communicates extremely well in English, is comfortable speaking with U.S. customers, learns quickly, and can move between customer service and administrative work throughout the day.



Responsibilities



-Customer Service & Phone Support-



* Answer incoming customer calls professionally and promptly

* Make outbound calls for customer follow-up when needed

* Respond to customer text messages and emails

* Schedule, reschedule, and confirm appointments

* Answer customer questions about our services

* Follow up with leads and existing customers

* Handle customer questions or concerns calmly and professionally

* Communicate important customer or scheduling information to our team

* Accurately document customer conversations and next steps

* Help create a positive customer experience from the first interaction through service completion



-Administrative Support-



* Enter and update customer information in our CRM and other systems

* Perform routine data entry and database cleanup

* Maintain accurate customer and appointment records

* Help prepare and update reports

* Track basic business metrics and organize information for management

* Work with spreadsheets and reporting tools

* Review data for missing or inaccurate information

* Assist with other administrative projects as needed



-Social Media & General Support-

* Make simple updates to social media accounts as directed

* Help prepare or organize content for posting

* Assist with other projects and office tasks as the business grows



Requirements



* Excellent spoken English with clear, easy-to-understand communication

* Excellent written English and grammar

* Strong customer service and telephone skills

* Comfortable speaking with U.S. customers throughout the workday

* Previous experience in customer service, receptionist, call center, appointment setting, administrative support, or Virtual Assistant work preferred

* Strong attention to detail

* Strong organizational and time-management skills

* Comfortable working with spreadsheets, reports, and data

* Ability to manage multiple tasks and switch priorities throughout the day

* Ability to work independently without constant supervision

* Strong problem-solving skills and good judgment

* Comfortable learning new software and systems

* Experience with Google Workspace, including Gmail, Google Sheets, and Google Docs

* Basic social media experience is preferred

* Reliable high-speed internet connection

* Reliable computer and quality headset

* Quiet, professional workspace with minimal background noise during customer calls



What We're Looking For



We are looking for someone who is more than just a task-based Virtual Assistant.



We want someone who can become a dependable part of our team, communicate professionally with customers, stay productive when phones are quiet, and take ownership of their responsibilities.



The ideal candidate is:



* Warm, friendly, and personable

* Confident speaking with customers on the phone

* Dependable and punctual

* Detail-oriented and organized

* Comfortable working with numbers, spreadsheets, and reports

* Able to follow processes consistently

* Proactive and able to find productive work during slower periods

* Comfortable receiving feedback and learning new responsibilities

* Able to solve basic problems without needing constant direction

* Able to work independently while communicating well with a team

* Interested in becoming a long-term member of a growing company



Because you will regularly communicate with customers in the United States, strong conversational English, excellent listening comprehension, and a professional phone presence are essential for this position.



Position Details



* Fully remote

* Salary position

* Paid weekly

* Consistent work schedule

* Long-term opportunity with a growing company



How to Apply



Please include the following with your application:



1. A brief description of your previous customer service and administrative experience

2. The types of customer calls you have handled

3. Your experience with data entry, spreadsheets, reporting, or CRM systems

4. Any experience you have helping manage social media accounts

5. Your internet speed and computer/headset setup

6. Video Introduction



Please follow the directions below to submit your video introduction.



Send us a short video so we can get a feel for your personality, communication skills, and spoken English.



Please use the following script/template as a guide:



Hi, my name is [Your First Name], and I’m currently based in [Your City & Country].



I’m excited about the Customer Service & Administrative Virtual Assistant role because [share 1–2 reasons — this could be about the opportunity for growth, working with customers, being part of a growing company, or the type of work you enjoy].

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to join your team and contribute to the company!

* Look directly into the camera and speak clearly

* Find a quiet space with good lighting

* Make sure we can hear your audio clearly

* Keep it natural — we want to get a feel for your personality, not hear a rehearsed sales pitch

* Be yourself and let your personality come through

* Smile! :)



When you're finished, upload your video to Google Drive, Dropbox, or YouTube as an unlisted video and include the link with your application.



**Please make sure we have permission to view the video before submitting your application.



Applications that do not include the requested video may not be considered.



We are looking for someone who wants to become a reliable, long-term member of our team. If you communicate extremely well in English, enjoy helping customers, are organized and detail-oriented, and are comfortable balancing phone support with administrative work, we would love to hear from you.

title: Behavioral Health RCM Lead – PHP/IOP Billing & Collections (US Client, Remote)
description:
A US-based outpatient behavioral health provider (PHP/IOP levels of care) needs a hands-on Revenue Cycle lead to own billing and collections end-to-end. You'll be the person keeping cash flow healthy — clean claims out the door, denials chased down, and AR aging under control — for a growing outpatient treatment program.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

- Full-cycle billing for PHP and IOP claims: charge entry, coding review, and timely claims submission (UB-04/CMS-1500) to commercial payers

- Insurance verification and authorization tracking for new and continuing clients, including concurrent review submissions

- Denial management: research, appeal, and resubmit denied/underpaid claims, tracking root causes to reduce recurring denials

- Payment posting and reconciliation against EOBs/ERAs

- AR aging oversight — proactively work claims past 30/60/90 days rather than waiting on reports

- Payer follow-up calls and portal work across commercial behavioral health payers

- Monthly reporting to leadership on collections, denial rates, AR days, and net revenue trends

- Coordination with clinical/admin staff to fix documentation or authorization gaps upstream before they cause denials



WHAT YOU BRING

- 3+ years in US medical billing/RCM, with direct experience in behavioral health (PHP/IOP or SUD treatment billing specifically — not just general medical billing)

- Working knowledge of behavioral health CPT/HCPCS codes (H0015, S9480, etc.) and payer-specific PHP/IOP requirements

- Experience with a billing/EHR platform such as Kipu, CollaborateMD, TheraNest, or similar

- Comfortable owning denial appeals independently, not just flagging them

- Strong written English for payer correspondence and internal reporting

- Reliable overlap with US business hours



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience managing or mentoring a junior biller

- Familiarity with utilization review/concurrent authorization workflows

- Google Sheets/Excel fluency for building your own AR tracking views



SCREENING QUESTIONS (please answer in your application)

1. How many years of hands-on PHP/IOP (or SUD) billing experience do you have, and which platform(s) did you bill on?

2. Walk me through how you'd work a claim that's been denied for "authorization not on file."

3. What was your AR-over-90-days percentage in your most recent role, and how did you keep it there?

4. What US time zone hours can you reliably overlap?

5. What's your expected monthly rate?

title: SEO & AI Visibility CSM
description:
# SEO & AI Visibility Client Success Manager



## About SaaSLaunch



SaaSLaunch helps SaaS companies grow through predictable acquisition systems, AI-powered search visibility, and high-performing digital infrastructure.



We're looking for an **SEO & AI Visibility Client Success Manager** to take ownership of client communication and oversee the execution of our SEO, AEO, and GEO services.



This is **not a traditional SEO specialist role where you'll spend your entire day writing articles or manually doing SEO work.**



You'll be responsible for making sure our clients get results.



You'll communicate directly with clients, coordinate with our developers, QA website and landing page work, identify opportunities, and make sure everything that needs to get done actually gets done.



You'll also use our internal software and systems to manage blogs, articles, artifacts, website scans, AI visibility analysis, and other SEO/AEO/GEO initiatives.



## About the Role



You'll own a portfolio of SaaS clients and act as the bridge between the client and our execution team.



A typical day might include reviewing a client's website, identifying pages that should be created or improved, assigning changes to our developer, QA'ing completed work, making small website or Google Business Profile updates, reviewing visibility data, and communicating progress to the client.



We're looking for someone who takes initiative.



If you notice a client needs a new page, you shouldn't wait for someone to tell you to create it. You should identify the opportunity, coordinate with the developer, QA the finished work, and make sure it gets launched.



Our systems handle much of the heavy lifting. Your job is to **manage, oversee, QA, communicate, and continuously look for ways to improve client results.**



## Responsibilities



* Own day-to-day communication with assigned clients

* Build strong client relationships and keep clients informed on progress

* Oversee SEO, AEO, and GEO execution across client accounts

* Review client websites and identify opportunities for improvement

* Coordinate website and landing page changes with our developer

* Request new pages when opportunities are identified

* QA landing pages, website changes, content, and other deliverables before they go live

* Optimize existing website pages when needed

* Make smaller website and Google Business Profile updates

* Use our internal software to manage blogs, articles, artifacts, scans, analysis, and AI visibility initiatives

* Review SEO and AI visibility performance and determine what should happen next

* Identify problems or opportunities before the client has to point them out

* Keep developers and other team members accountable for completing client work

* Ensure client accounts continue moving forward without requiring founder involvement



## You're a Strong Fit If You



* Have experience with SEO, AEO, GEO, website management, or digital marketing

* Understand the fundamentals of on-page and technical SEO

* Are comfortable working with websites, landing pages, Google Search Console, and Google Business Profile

* Can review a landing page or website and identify obvious problems or opportunities

* Are comfortable communicating directly with clients

* Can translate technical work into simple updates clients understand

* Have experience coordinating developers, designers, writers, or other specialists

* Are highly organized and can manage multiple client accounts simultaneously

* Take initiative instead of waiting to be given every task

* Follow up relentlessly when something needs to get completed

* Are comfortable learning new AI and SEO software quickly

* Care about client results and retention, not simply completing a checklist



Experience working with SaaS or B2B companies is a major plus.



## What Success Looks Like



**Client Success:** Clients are happy, informed, seeing progress, and getting measurable results.



**Ownership:** Accounts move forward without the founders needing to manage day-to-day execution.



**Execution:** Website changes, new pages, optimizations, and deliverables are completed quickly and correctly.



**Quality:** Work is properly reviewed and QA'd before reaching the client or going live.



**Initiative:** You're constantly identifying the next opportunity to improve a client's SEO, AEO, and GEO performance.



## How to Apply



Apply here:





Please include:



* A 1-minute Loom video introducing yourself

* Relevant SEO, website management, client success, or project management experience

* Examples of SEO results or websites you've worked on

* An explanation of how you've managed clients, developers, or other team members in the past



**Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.**



We're looking for someone who takes ownership. If something can improve a client's results, we want someone who identifies it, gets it implemented, verifies it was done correctly, and communicates the progress to the client.

title: E-commerce Bookkeeper (QuickBooks Online) — Multi-Platform Payout Reconciliation
description:
E-commerce Bookkeeper (QuickBooks Online) — Multi-Platform Payout Reconciliation



JOB TYPE: Full-time



SALARY: $2,500/month



LOCATION: Remote



JOB DESCRIPTION:



We're a US-based bookkeeping practice serving e-commerce and retail clients, and we're looking for a senior bookkeeper who already understands the part of this work that trips most people up: reconciling what a sales platform reports against what actually hits the bank.



This is not a data-entry role. You'll own client books independently and review work done by others, so you need to genuinely understand why a payout never matches gross sales — fees, refunds, chargebacks, sales tax, held funds, and platform financing repayments that live in a separate report from the sales data.

What you'll do:



Own monthly close for multiple e-commerce clients in QuickBooks Online — categorization, reconciliation, and clean financials.



Reconcile platform payouts to bank deposits, correctly separating gross sales, processing fees, refunds, and sales tax rather than booking the net deposit as revenue.



Set up and maintain clearing accounts so sales, fees, and payouts flow correctly.



Handle platform financing (e.g., Square Loans / Capital, Shopify Capital, PayPal Working Capital): book the funding as a liability, split repayments into principal vs. fee, and reconcile the liability against the platform's own loan/balance report each month.



Account for cash sales, owner draws, and tender-type differences.



Review junior bookkeepers' work and catch reconciliation errors before they reach the client.



Required:



3+ years ecommerce bookkeeping, with strong QuickBooks Online expertise.

Hands-on experience reconciling at least two of these: Square, Shopify, Stripe, Amazon, PayPal, Etsy.

A real understanding of the payout-vs-sales gap and how to use a platform's reports to explain it.

Strong written English and reliable overlap with US business hours (some hours between 9am–5pm Pacific Time).

Accuracy, discretion with financial data, and the ability to work independently.



Nice to have:



Experience across several of the platforms above.

Familiarity with platform financing products and how their repayments are reported.

QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification.



**Screening — to apply, complete all of these:**

Send the following to our WhatsApp at 
:



1. Start your application with the word PAYOUT so we know you read this post in full.

2. Answer this in 3–5 sentences: A client's Square sales report shows $10,000 in gross sales for the month, but only $8,900 was deposited to their bank, and they have an active Square Loan. Walk us through what makes up that $1,100 difference and which report you'd pull to confirm the loan portion.

3. Your resume (PDF)

4. A 1–2 minute video introduction telling us about your e-commerce bookkeeping experience and which platforms you've reconciled.



Applications without the keyword, a real answer to the question, and a WhatsApp submission (resume + video) will not be reviewed.

How many calls did I make?

How many people did I actually speak with?

How many meaningful conversations did I have?

How many leads did I qualify?

How many appointments did I schedule?

How many appointments were confirmed?

How many leads require follow-up?

Which opportunities are closest to converting?

Which leads are becoming stale?

Where are leads getting stuck?



We are looking for someone who enjoys improving these numbers rather than someone who simply wants to complete a shift.



Important Work Requirements



This is a dedicated full-time position.



You may not hold another full-time job or provide overlapping services to other clients during our scheduled working hours.



You must have fluent, professional-level spoken and written English. You will regularly speak directly with prospective buyers, sellers, clients, agents, and management.



Our team works collaboratively on Zoom throughout the workday, and you must be comfortable remaining connected on Zoom and sharing your screen while working when required.



You will work closely with management and our real estate team, so communication, transparency, availability, accountability, and responsiveness are essential.



You must also have:



A professional and quiet working environment.

Reliable high-speed internet.

A reliable computer.

A quality headset/microphone.

Backup internet access whenever possible.

The ability to work our required schedule consistently.

The Personality We Want



We want someone who is sharp, hungry, resourceful, confident, and self-driven.



If a lead does not answer, you don't simply mark them as "no answer" and forget about them.



You think:



When should I call again?

Should I text them?

Should I
 them?

What did they originally inquire about?

What might get them to respond?

What's their timeline?

What is the next action?



You should naturally want to move opportunities forward.



We value people who see a problem, communicate it, and work toward solving it rather than waiting for someone to give them instructions.
