title: Facade / Cladding Shop Drawing Drafter & Takeoff Specialist
description:
Built Exteriors is a commercial exterior construction subcontractor in the United States looking for an experienced Facade / Cladding Shop Drawing Drafter & Takeoff Specialist to join our team remotely.



This is not a general virtual assistant position.



We are looking for someone with strong construction knowledge who can read architectural plans, perform accurate quantity takeoffs, and create professional exterior facade and cladding shop drawings using AutoCAD.



The ideal candidate already has experience producing shop drawings for exterior building systems and understands how to turn architectural design documents into detailed drawings that can be used for submittals, project coordination, material planning, and field installation.



What We Build



Our exterior scopes include systems such as:



Fiber cement siding and panels

EIFS and stucco

ACM and architectural metal panels

Sheet metal

Soffits and fascia

Weather barriers

Flashings

Exterior trim systems

High-end architectural cladding

Other commercial building-envelope systems



Our projects include multifamily buildings, commercial buildings, schools, government facilities, healthcare projects, and other large commercial construction.



Primary Responsibilities

Facade and Cladding Shop Drawings



You will review architectural construction documents for projects awarded to our company and develop shop drawings specifically for our exterior scopes.



Responsibilities may include:



Review architectural plans, elevations, sections, wall types, details, specifications, and addenda.

Create professional shop drawing packages in AutoCAD.

Develop exterior elevations showing our materials and scopes.

Create wall sections and enlarged construction details.

Create original details based on architectural documents, manufacturer requirements, and project conditions.

Detail window heads, jambs, and sills.

Detail door and storefront conditions.

Detail inside and outside corners.

Detail vertical and horizontal material transitions.

Detail base-of-wall conditions.

Detail parapets, soffits, fascia, balconies, penetrations, and other exterior conditions.

Show weather barrier, flashing, drainage, furring, cladding, trim, sealant, and related components where applicable.

Identify our work versus adjacent work or work by others.

Create material legends, detail callouts, notes, dimensions, and drawing references.

Revise shop drawings based on GC, architect, project manager, manufacturer, or field comments.

Maintain organized drawing sets and revision histories.

Help develop standard details and drafting libraries that can be reused on future projects.



We are not looking for someone who simply traces architectural drawings.



We want someone who can understand how exterior systems actually come together and use construction judgment when developing shop drawings.



Quantity Takeoffs



This position will also support our estimating department.



Responsibilities include:



Review commercial architectural construction documents.

Perform accurate exterior quantity takeoffs.

Use PlanSwift or similar professional takeoff software.

Measure siding, panels, stucco/EIFS, sheet metal, soffits, fascia, flashing, trim, weather barrier, and other exterior materials.

Separate quantities by material, elevation, color, system, building area, or other required breakdown.

Identify missing scope, inconsistencies, unusual conditions, and potential estimating questions.

Clearly document assumptions.

Provide organized takeoff information that our U.S.-based estimators can easily review.

Required Qualifications



You must have:



Extensive professional AutoCAD experience

Strong ability to create architectural and construction drawings

Experience producing shop drawings, fabrication drawings, installation drawings, or detailed construction drawings

Ability to independently draw construction details

Strong ability to read commercial architectural plans

Strong understanding of:

Plans

Elevations

Sections

Wall assemblies

Construction details

Dimensions

Material transitions

Building-envelope conditions

Experience performing construction quantity takeoffs

Experience with PlanSwift or another professional takeoff software

Strong attention to detail

Strong written English communication

Ability to recognize missing information and ask questions instead of making unsupported assumptions

Ability to organize technical information clearly and professionally

Reliable computer and internet connection

Strongly Preferred Experience



We are particularly interested in candidates with experience in:



Facade or cladding shop drawings

ACM / aluminum composite material

Metal panels

Fiber cement siding or panels

EIFS

Stucco

Architectural sheet metal

Curtain wall

Storefront

Waterproofing

Weather barriers

Rainscreen assemblies

Roofing

Building-envelope systems



Experience working with U.S. commercial construction documents is strongly preferred.



Experience with the following software is also valuable:



AutoCAD

PlanSwift

Bluebeam Revu

Revit

On-Screen Takeoff

Excel



AutoCAD proficiency is mandatory.



What We Are Looking For



We want someone who can eventually look at an exterior building condition and think beyond simply what is drawn.



For example:



How will this actually be installed?

What material terminates here?

How does the weather barrier transition?

Is flashing required?

What is included in our scope?

What belongs to another trade?

Does the architectural detail provide enough information?

Does the detail make sense?

Is additional information required from the architect or GC?

What does our field crew need to see to correctly install this condition?



You do not need to know every Built Exteriors system on your first day.



We will train the right person on our specific materials, systems, standards, and workflows.



However, you must already be highly competent in construction drafting, AutoCAD, and architectural plan reading.



REQUIRED APPLICATION MATERIALS



Please read this section carefully.



We will not review incomplete applications.



Every application must include:



Resume

Technical drafting portfolio

Completed quantity takeoff assessment

Completed shop drawing assessment

Desired hourly compensation

Years of professional AutoCAD experience

Years of construction drafting/shop drawing experience

Years of estimating/quantity takeoff experience

List of drafting and takeoff software you are proficient in

PORTFOLIO REQUIRED



DO NOT APPLY WITHOUT A PORTFOLIO.



Your portfolio must contain examples of technical drawings you personally produced.



We want to see examples such as:



Facade shop drawings

Cladding shop drawings

Exterior elevations

Wall sections

Construction details

Window, door, storefront, parapet, flashing, soffit, or transition details

Fabrication drawings

Installation drawings

Architectural construction drawings



Renderings alone are not sufficient.



We are evaluating your ability to produce technical construction drawings that can actually be used for coordination, submittals, fabrication, or installation.



Applications without a technical drafting portfolio will not be considered.



REQUIRED SKILLS ASSESSMENT



Every applicant must also complete our technical assessment.



All assessment files can be found here:







IMPORTANT: READ BEFORE STARTING



The Dropbox folder contains files for two different projects/purposes.



TEST PROJECT



The files labeled:



01 - TEST PROJECT - Marmalade Permit Set



and



02 - TEST PROJECT - Material Legend



are the files you will use to complete your assessment.



You will perform BOTH your:



Quantity takeoff

Shop drawings



using the Marmalade Permit Set.



REFERENCE SHOP DRAWINGS ONLY



The file labeled:



03 - REFERENCE ONLY - Example Exterior Shop Drawings



is provided only to show you an example of the type and level of shop drawing package we produce.



DO NOT perform a takeoff of the reference project.



DO NOT recreate the reference project.



Use it only as an example of how exterior subcontractor shop drawings may be organized and detailed.



PART 1: QUANTITY TAKEOFF



Using the Marmalade Permit Set and provided Material Legend, prepare an exterior quantity takeoff.



PlanSwift is preferred.



You may use another professional takeoff program if necessary.



Your takeoff should clearly identify and quantify the exterior materials included in the provided Material Legend.



We want to be able to understand:



What you measured

Where you measured it

How much you measured

How you organized the quantities

Any assumptions you made

Any unclear conditions you discovered

Any questions you would ask before finalizing the estimate

Submit:

Quantity summary

PDF or screenshots showing your takeoff

Native PlanSwift or takeoff file, if available

List of assumptions

List of questions, discrepancies, or missing information you identified

Approximate time spent completing the takeoff

PART 2: EXTERIOR SHOP DRAWINGS



Using the same Marmalade Permit Set, create an exterior-scope shop drawing package using AutoCAD or comparable professional CAD software.



Use the provided example shop drawings to understand the type of work we are looking for.



We do not expect you to copy the example exactly.



We want to evaluate your ability to independently interpret architectural documents and develop professional exterior subcontractor shop drawings.



Your package should demonstrate, as applicable to the test project:



Exterior elevations

Exterior material identification

Material legend

Relevant dimensions

Detail callouts

Exterior wall/cladding details

Material transition details

Termination conditions

Window and door conditions

Inside and outside corners

Base-of-wall conditions

Parapets

Soffits/fascia

Flashing

Weather barrier relationships

Other important exterior conditions you identify



Clearly identify assumptions and information that requires clarification.



If the architectural drawings do not provide enough information to confidently detail a condition, do not simply invent an answer.



Instead, show your reasonable interpretation when appropriate and identify what question you would send to the project manager, general contractor, or architect.



Knowing when to ask a good construction question is part of what we are evaluating.



Submit:

PDF shop drawing package

Native DWG or other CAD files

List of assumptions

List of questions or clarifications

Approximate time spent completing the shop drawings

FINAL APPLICATION CHECKLIST



Your application must contain:



Resume

Technical drafting portfolio

Completed Marmalade quantity takeoff

Takeoff summary

Completed Marmalade shop drawing package

Native CAD file

Native takeoff file, if available

Assumptions/questions

Time spent on both portions of the assessment

Desired compensation

Software experience



If your application does not contain the portfolio AND completed assessment, it will not be reviewed.



One Final Question



In the first line of your application, tell us:



Which exterior facade or cladding system do you have the most experience detailing, and what type of shop drawings have you produced for it?



This helps us confirm that you carefully reviewed the position before applying.



Position Opportunity



This is intended to be a long-term role.



The right person can become an important technical resource supporting both our estimating and project teams.



As your knowledge of our exterior systems grows, we expect the position to expand beyond basic drafting into greater responsibility for:



Exterior shop drawing production

Standard details

Project-specific detailing

Takeoffs

Constructability review

Drawing coordination

Field installation drawings

Process improvement and standardization



We are looking for someone who wants to become highly knowledgeable in commercial exterior facade construction and grow with our team.

title: Staffing Coordinator
description:
We're currently looking to hire a Staffing Coordinator for an on-demand hospitality staffing startup.



This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, talking to people, solving problems, and keeping daily operations running smoothly. Most of your day will be spent making high-volume outbound calls, filling open shifts, supporting workers, and ensuring daily staffing needs are met.



You'll work closely with both workers and the internal operations team to ensure shifts are filled quickly, workers receive the support they need, and clients receive excellent service. From time to time, you'll also assist with hiring and onboarding when there are high-priority hiring needs or new market launches.



If you enjoy customer support, operations, and high-volume communication while staying organized in a fast-moving environment, we'd love to hear from you.



Responsibilities

- Make 75+ outbound calls per day, depending on staffing demand, to contact applicants, confirm availability, and fill open shifts

- Move applicants through the staffing process, from initial outreach and screening through availability confirmation and onboarding

- Manage multiple open shifts and staffing requests in real time, prioritizing urgent staffing needs

- Follow up with applicants and workers regarding shifts, availability, reminders, and schedule changes

- Support applicants and workers by answering questions and resolving issues throughout the staffing process

- Assist with certifications, document verification, W-2 onboarding, and other required paperwork

- Track applicant, worker, and staffing activity accurately using Google Sheets and internal systems

- Work closely with the operations team to resolve last-minute staffing challenges and keep shifts covered

- Provide detailed feedback on processes, workflows, and internal tools, and suggest practical improvements

- Assist with hiring activities during high-priority hiring periods or new market launches, including applicant screening and interview coordination

- Maintain a strong worker experience while providing reliable support to hospitality clients

- Handle other operational tasks as needed to support daily staffing operations



Requirements 

- 2+ years of experience in high-volume operations, customer support, staffing, workforce management, onboarding, or a similar role supporting US-based clients

- Comfortable making 75+ outbound calls per day and speaking with a high volume of applicants or workers

- Strong communication skills and the ability to handle a high volume of conversations professionally

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail when managing multiple applicants, workers, shifts, and changing priorities

- Experience working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change throughout the day

- Previous recruiting or staffing experience is a plus, especially experience with high-volume applicant pipelines or shift-based staffing

- Experience supporting applicants, workers, customers, or contractors through questions, issues, or onboarding

- Comfortable using Google Sheets, CRMs, internal platforms, and other operational tools

- Able to identify problems, provide detailed and useful feedback, and suggest practical improvements

- Able to learn new systems quickly, take feedback, and adapt to changing processes

- Proven ability to work independently and take ownership of day-to-day responsibilities

- Previous experience in hospitality, workforce marketplaces, or shift-based environments is a plus

- Experience with automation tools (e.g., Zapier, Airtable) is a plus.

- Must be available to work a graveyard shift aligned with U.S. time zones

- Reliable internet connection and a dedicated work-from-home setup required



Salary and Benefits

- Base salary: 65,000 PHP per month

- Paid Time Off + Paid Holidays

This will help us identify your application quickly and also shows that you’ve read the entire job description (attention to detail is important for this role). Thanks and hope to hear from you soon!

title: Executive + Growth Assistant | Long-Form YouTube Editor
description:
Executive + Growth Assistant | Long-Form YouTube Editor



Part-Time | 15–20 Hours/Week - Goal to grow revenue to move to full time within 60/90 days based on direct revenue growth

We are a founder-led U.S. coaching business serving high-performing women in real estate.



Our work is warm, faith-based, direct and focused on helping women build profitable businesses, wealth and lives they actually have time to enjoy.



You will work directly with our founder, Saundra Kandler, and become a key person in a small, growing company.



This is not a traditional VA role.



I am looking for someone who becomes my right hand in execution, someone who thinks ahead, communicates constantly, takes ownership and helps turn fast-moving ideas into results.



You must also already be an excellent, efficient long-form YouTube video editor.



BEFORE YOU APPLY, KNOW WHAT YOU'RE WALKING INTO



I move fast.



I think out loud.



I generate ideas quickly.



I coach, create, sell, speak, build relationships and drive the vision of the company.



I need someone beside me who naturally thinks:



What happens next?



You notice what's coming.



You follow up without waiting to be asked.



You remind me when I need reminding.



You catch mistakes before I see them.



You ask smart questions when something isn't clear.



You communicate before something becomes a problem.



You understand the result we're trying to create, not simply the task you've been assigned.



Sometimes I want to hear:



“Saundra, I noticed this and already handled it.”



Or:



“Here's what I found. Here's what I recommend.”



Or:



“I need this from you today so we stay ahead.”



If you prefer receiving a perfectly prepared task list and working quietly on your own, this will probably not be the right role.



If you love being trusted, solving problems, collaborating closely with a founder and taking ownership, keep reading.



YOUR FIRST MISSION: HELP US SELL EVENT TICKETS



We're hiring at an important moment.



We have an immediate, measurable business priority.



We have approximately one week to significantly increase ticket sales for an upcoming live event.



One of your first responsibilities will be helping us personally reach top women in real estate across approximately 15 priority U.S. markets.



This is not an assignment to simply create a few event graphics and schedule posts.



We need action.



You will help:



Research and identify high-performing women in real estate in our priority markets

Build and maintain accurate prospect lists

Help send thoughtful, personalized DMs and outreach

Track every person contacted

Track responses, conversations and follow-up

Identify warm prospects who need personal outreach from Saundra

Make sure interested prospects receive timely follow-up

Keep our contact and CRM information current

Track registrations against our goal

Identify which messages and approaches are producing conversations

Adjust quickly based on what is working

Keep Saundra focused on the highest-value conversations

Look for additional opportunities to increase registrations



You will not personally control whether someone buys a ticket.



You WILL own the quality, consistency, tracking and follow-through of the actions within your control.



Sending a certain number of DMs and checking the task off the list is not the goal.



I want someone looking at the numbers and asking:



“Are our actions producing the result we need? If not, what should we change?”



THE LONG-TERM MISSION



After this immediate event push, the mission remains simple:



Protect the founder's time, help create revenue, execute our content at a high level and make sure important things get finished.



Success means that over time:



I carry less in my head because you are here.



You know what's coming.



You know what's open.



You know what needs my attention.



You know what you can handle without me.



And things don't quietly fall through the cracks.



LONG-FORM YOUTUBE VIDEO EDITING



This is a required technical skill, not a bonus.



Every week, you will independently take approximately one long-form video from raw footage to a polished, professional, YouTube-ready final product.



You must already be able to:



Edit long-form talking-head, coaching or educational videos efficiently

Make intelligent cuts without being told where every cut belongs

Remove mistakes, unnecessary pauses and distractions

Create engaging pacing

Clean and balance audio

Add tasteful B-roll, graphics and text when they improve the video

Maintain a sophisticated, professional visual style

Catch editing mistakes before I see them

Create or support strong thumbnails

Upload and correctly format videos on YouTube

Help optimize titles and descriptions

Meet deadlines consistently



I should not have to re-edit your edits.



If you are still learning long-form video editing, please do not apply.



EXECUTIVE SUPPORT



This is where this position differs from a traditional content or social media VA.



You are helping me run the business.



You will help with:



Calendar awareness and meeting reminders

Tracking deadlines and commitments

Following up with me when you need something

Preparing information before meetings

Client and prospect follow-up

Research

Maintaining project and task systems

Keeping open loops visible

Creating simple SOPs for recurring work

Making sure important commitments actually get completed



Here's a simple example:



If we have a meeting at 10:00 AM and I haven't joined by 10:03, message me.



If you need something from me on Wednesday to meet a Friday deadline, ask me before Wednesday.



If instructions are unclear, ask rather than guessing.



If you discover a problem, bring me the problem and what you recommend we do about it.



If something might be late, tell me before it's late.



I should gradually have to remember less, not more, because you're here.



CONTENT + MARKETING



We are not interested in producing content simply to hit a posting quota.



I care about quality, consistency and business impact.



You will help:



Repurpose our weekly YouTube video into strategic short-form content

Edit Reels and Shorts

Create polished Canva graphics when needed

Schedule content across Instagram,
 and 

Help build and schedule our weekly

Create promotional content for events and offers

Maintain our content calendar

Proofread and quality-check everything before publishing

Use ChatGPT and other AI tools intelligently

Track what is working and help us improve



You need a strong visual eye.



Quality matters.



Accuracy matters.



LIVE MEETINGS ARE PART OF THIS JOB



Please read this section carefully.



This is NOT an asynchronous-only role.



You will work directly with me through regular live Google Meet or Zoom conversations, generally several times per week during agreed U.S. Eastern Time hours.



There may also be times when you join a planning, client or event-related meeting when your work is relevant.



You must genuinely enjoy live collaboration and be comfortable on camera.



I think out loud, and some of our best work will happen through real-time conversation.



Your responsibility is to listen carefully, ask intelligent questions, capture what matters and turn the conversation into action.



After our meeting, I should not have to sit down and create your task list for you.



You should leave knowing:



What you own.

What I own.

What happens next.



Please do not apply if regular live video meetings feel inconvenient, you strongly prefer asynchronous-only work, you are uncomfortable being on camera, or you want a role where you rarely interact directly with the founder.



There is nothing wrong with preferring that environment.



It simply isn't this position.



COMMUNICATION



I want an over-communicator.



You will never bother me by respectfully reminding me about something important.



I want to know what's completed, what's still open, what you need from me, what may be at risk and what you believe should happen next.



If something is unclear, ask.



If you need something, follow up.



If you make a mistake, tell me, correct it and learn from it.



If something changes, communicate early.



If you notice an opportunity, speak up.



Silence creates more work. Communication creates trust.



RELIABILITY IS NON-NEGOTIABLE



Because this role includes live collaboration, executive support and video production, you must have a dependable work setup.



You need:



Strong, reliable primary internet

Backup internet, such as mobile/hotspot or a second provider

A backup power solution

A reliable computer capable of efficiently editing long-form video

A dependable workspace



Unexpected things happen.



What matters is preparation and communication.



Repeated internet, power or equipment issues that prevent consistent work will make this role difficult.



HOW YOU THINK MATTERS



I do not expect you to know everything.



I DO expect you to think before asking me to think for you.



When you encounter something you don't know:



Research it.



Use AI.



Look at our existing systems.



Think through the options.



Then come to me with a recommendation when appropriate.



I am looking for someone who naturally asks:



What outcome are we trying to create?



What happens next?



What could fall through the cracks?



What can I handle without Saundra?



What actually needs Saundra?



You are being hired for your skills and your brain.



Please use both.



EXPERIENCE + SKILLS



You should have:



Proven long-form YouTube editing experience

Excellent written and spoken English

Strong Canva skills

Social media/content publishing experience

Strong attention to detail

Experience using ChatGPT or other AI tools

Google Workspace experience

Project/task management experience

Ability to research and learn technology quickly



Experience with CRM systems,
 marketing, events, coaching businesses, personal brands or real estate is a plus.



HOURS + COMPENSATION



This role will begin at approximately 15–20 hours per week.



Consistent overlap with U.S. Eastern Time is required.



There is an opportunity for responsibilities, hours and compensation to grow as the company grows and trust is established.



Please include your desired monthly compensation for 15–20 hours per week when applying.



HOW TO APPLY



Please read carefully.



Your application is your first assignment.



Generic applications will not be considered.



Start your application with:



I STAY AHEAD | [YOUR FIRST NAME]



Then answer the following 7 questions.



1. SHOW ME YOUR WORK



Send links to two long-form YouTube videos you personally edited.



For each, tell me what you personally handled, what software you used, approximately how long the raw footage was and approximately how many hours the edit took you.



Applications without long-form editing examples will not move forward.



2. YOUR 7-DAY PLAN



Imagine today is your first day.



We tell you:



We have 7 days to significantly increase ticket sales for our live event.



We want to personally reach high-performing women in real estate across our 15 priority U.S. markets.



You have access to our social media accounts, existing audience and contacts, CRM/contact lists, event information, registration page, existing content, AI tools and Saundra for high-value personal outreach.



You have approximately 15–20 working hours this week.



Walk me through what you would do during those seven days to give us the best possible chance of hitting our ticket goal.



Tell me:



How would you identify the right women?



How would you approach personalized outreach without making it feel like spam?



What would YOU handle?



What would you ask Saundra to handle?



What would you track each day?



How would you know whether your actions were working?



If we were behind pace after Day 3, what would you change?



Be specific.



I am less interested in a textbook marketing answer than I am in seeing how you think.



3. PRIORITIZE



You begin work and discover:



Our event registration link isn't working

Five warm event prospects need follow-up

Our weekly YouTube video is due tomorrow

Three social posts need to be created

I have an important meeting later today



What do you handle first, second and third, and why?



4. OWNERSHIP



Tell me about one real situation where you noticed something your employer or client needed before they asked you.



What did you notice?



What did you do?



What happened?



5. LIVE COLLABORATION



Tell me about your ideal working relationship with a founder.



How frequently did you meet live with your most recent founder, executive or client?



What did you personally do during and immediately after those meetings?



What do you enjoy about working closely with a founder in real time?



What do you find challenging about it?



6. RELIABILITY



Tell me:



What computer you use for video editing

Your primary internet setup and typical speed

Your backup internet solution

Your backup power solution

What U.S. Eastern Time hours you can consistently overlap

How many hours per week you can commit

7. WHAT DO YOU SEE THAT I DON'T?



After reading this entire job description:



What is one thing you believe I will need from you that I haven't specifically asked for?



Finally, tell me your desired monthly compensation for 15–20 hours per week.



At the very END of your application, write:



Details create trust.



Finalists will complete a live video interview followed by a paid practical assignment before an offer is made.



If you love producing excellent work, solving problems, communicating clearly, collaborating closely with a founder and being the person already thinking about tomorrow, I would love to hear from you.

title: Sales-Focused Virtual Assistant (Strong Closer with Admin Skills) – U.S. Cleaning Business
description:
We are a fast-growing, U.S.-based home services company looking for a powerhouse Sales-Focused Virtual Assistant to manage our pipeline and close incoming leads. This is not a cold-calling role—you will be dealing with warm leads who have already expressed interest in our services. Your job is to build instant rapport, handle objections professionally, and lock in the booking.



If you are a disciplined closer, a confident communicator, and highly organized, we want you on our team.



Key Responsibilities

-Close the Deal: Handle inbound phone calls from warm leads, confidently walk them through pricing and packages, and secure the booking.



-Follow Up: Conduct strategic outbound follow-up calls to leads who requested a quote but did not book immediately.



-Overcome Objections: Professionally navigate common objections regarding pricing, scheduling, and trust.



-CRM and Admin Mastery: Maintain precise records in our CRM, log post-call notes, send follow-up
s, and manage the booking calendar.



-Customer Care: Ensure a seamless, high-quality experience for clients from the first interaction to the final booking confirmation.



What We Are Looking For

-Flawless English: Exceptional verbal and written English with a neutral, confident, and professional tone.



-Proven Sales Track Record: At least 1–2 years of experience in phone sales, telemarketing, or high-volume customer service. Experience with the U.S. market is a major asset.



-The Closer Mindset: You view objections as an opportunity to educate and convert rather than a rejection.



-Tech Savvy and Organized: Experience with CRMs, VoIP systems (such as RingCentral, OpenPhone, or Aircall), and Google Workspace.



-Reliability: A self-starter who can work independently during U.S. business hours without constant supervision.



Technical Requirements

-Internet: Reliable, wired fiber internet connection (Minimum 30 Mbps) with a backup power and internet solution for power outages.



-Environment: A dedicated, completely quiet home office setup with a noise-canceling headset.



Compensation and Hours

-Base Salary: $5.50 – $6.00 USD per hour (depending on experience).



-Uncapped Commission: Earn an additional bonus for every successfully booked and completed cleaning job.



-Hours: Full-time (40 hours per week), Monday to Friday during U.S. Business Hours. Please specify if you operate on Eastern or Pacific time.



How to Apply (Read Carefully)

We value attention to detail. To be considered for this role, please reply with the subject line: "I am your next Sales Rockstar - [Your Name]" and include the following:



A link to your resume or CV.



A link to a 2-minute Loom or Vocaroo audio/video recording introducing yourself and describing a time you successfully handled a tough customer objection to close a sale.



A screenshot of your internet speed test.



Applications without the requested audio/video sample and the correct subject line will not be reviewed.

title: Paid Media Manager (Agile/Growth Focused)
description:
Overview

We are looking for a highly execution-focused Paid Media Manager to own and operate the company's lead generation campaigns across multiple ad platforms (Meta, Google, LinkedIn). This role is built around rapid campaign deployment, continuous testing, and performance-driven iteration.



You will be responsible for launching new campaigns on a monthly cadence tied to new lead magnets, optimizing performance quickly, and scaling or killing campaigns based on results.



This is not a traditional set it and optimize slowly ads role. We operate in fast cycles and expect quick turnaround, clear thinking, and proactive recommendations.



Key Responsibilities



Campaign Execution

• Launch new paid campaigns within 3–5 business days of receiving assets

• Build and manage campaigns across Meta, Google, and LinkedIn

• Maintain a consistent campaign structure to support rapid repeat of successes and drops of failures



Rapid Testing & Optimization

• Run structured tests on creative, copy, and audiences

• Monitor performance daily and make adjustments quickly

• Identify winning campaigns and scale them

• Shut down underperforming campaigns efficiently



Remarketing & Funnel Management

• Build and manage retargeting campaigns across platforms

• Ensure users are brought back into the funnel for conversion

• Optimize full-funnel performance (not just top-of-funnel clicks)



Strategic Input

• Provide clear recommendations on:

• Ad creative improvements

• Messaging and hooks

• Landing page or offer adjustments

• Translate performance data into actionable insights



Reporting & Visibility

• Maintain a centralized dashboard showing performance across all platforms

• Provide simple, clear weekly performance updates

• Ensure full transparency into campaign results and decisions



Required Experience

• Proven experience managing paid campaigns for lead generation

• Strong working knowledge of:

• Meta Ads

• Google Ads

• LinkedIn Ads (Preferred but not required)

• Experience with retargeting and conversion-focused funnels

• Ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously

• Comfortable working in fast-paced, iterative environments



What We're Looking For

• Fast executor — you can build and launch quickly without overcomplicating

• Data-driven — you rely on performance, not opinions

• Proactive — you don't wait to be told what to improve

• Strategic thinker — you understand how ads connect to the offer and funnel

• Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid change



Nice to Have

• Experience with tools like Looker Studio or other reporting platforms

• Familiarity with CRM-driven audiences and lead syncing

• Experience working with monthly campaign cycles or growth marketing team

title: GHL Marketing & CRM Automation Manager

 prospect books a consultation through payment, credit report intake, quote delivery, and follow-up until the client either closes or is confirmed dead. Responsible for building and running the automated follow-up sequences 
, SMS,
 Messenger), writing the content that goes in them, keeping the CRM pipeline clean, and reactivating the backlog of old leads.

This is not just a “run some ads” marketing role — it’s CRM operations + copywriting + automation, specific to a credit repair sales funnel.



Core Responsibilities

CRM & Pipeline Management

 • Build and maintain the GoHighLevel pipeline stages (e.g., Report Received → Quote Sent → Follow-Up → Closed/Lost)

 • Disposition every lead correctly and keep the pipeline clean — no stale or mis-tagged contacts

 • Set up and manage tags (e.g., old-lead-quote-only) for segmentation

Automation Build & Management

 • Build multi-channel follow-up workflows 
, SMS,
 Messenger) for stalled quotes

 domain warm-up/send-cap limits)

Content Creation

 and SMS copy for every stage of the follow-up sequence (initial nudge, mid-sequence, final reactivation attempt, etc.)

title: Paid Ads Manager
description:
Compensation: $2,000 USD/month



Time Commitment: Full-Time | 40 hours/week



Working Hours: 8:55am–5:00pm EST (or longer as required to get the work done)



Expected to work on the last and first day of each month to deactivate and reactivate campaigns. If these dates fall on a weekend, availability is required. A full compensatory day off will be provided the upcoming week.



Engagement Type: 1099 Independent Contractor



Location: Remote (US-based hours required)



English Mastery Notice: Native-sounding and command of spoken English (and, of course, written English, as this is a role involving writing) is imperative in this role to interact with your U.S. counterparts. Please don’t apply if you do not have this skillset. Additionally, having managed ads in the U.S. market, and having that understanding will be critical, as well.



Are you obsessive about accuracy, pacing, and execution?



Do you take pride in campaigns running cleanly, on budget, and exactly as intended?



Do you feel fulfilled when complex systems work because you built them correctly?



Final question: when faced with a challenge, do you get excited or run away?



If that sounds like you, you may be the perfect fit for our Paid Ads Manager role.



At Crisp, we're on a mission to help 10,000 law firms each grow their revenue by $10,000,000 over the next 10 years, creating a $10 billion impact in the legal industry.



Our Paid Ads Managers are responsible for the execution, monitoring, optimization, and quality control of paid media campaigns that power our clients’ brand awareness and growth across major digital platforms.



This is a non-client-facing, execution-heavy role that requires extreme attention to detail, comfort managing multiple campaigns simultaneously, and the discipline to follow structured internal processes with zero margin for preventable error.



** IMPORTANT: TO APPLY **



You will be evaluated and vetted based on your ability to follow instructions:



Follow the subsequent Willo link (recorded interview platform), and answer the few questions on there, first: 



Then reply to the ad, stating you’ve completed the Willo, and we will be in touch.



Key Responsibilities Include:



Campaign Execution & Launch



Build, launch, and manage paid advertising campaigns across Meta, Google Ads, LinkedIn, Reddit, TikTok, and Nextdoor, as well as launching streaming ads, using the platform TradeDesk across such streaming networks as Netflix, Hulu, live sports, and many others.

Execute campaigns using approved strategy decks, targeting parameters, creative assets, and ad copy.

Ensure all campaigns are launched accurately across the correct funnel stages (top, middle, and bottom).

Upload, organize, and verify all required video and static assets across platforms prior to launch.



Budget Management & Pacing



Manage and pace monthly ad budgets across multiple client accounts to ensure spend aligns with approved allocations.

Monitor pacing daily to avoid underdelivery or overspend.

Execute approved budget reallocations and platform shifts accurately and on time.



Performance Monitoring & Optimization



Monitor campaign performance daily to identify issues, inefficiencies, or opportunities for improvement.

Execute approved optimizations, including audience adjustments, creative refreshes, and funnel restructuring.

Support split tests by implementing test variables, tracking results, and documenting outcomes.



Quality Control & Error Prevention



Conduct rigorous pre-launch and post-launch audits to ensure:

Correct objectives are selected

Targeting and exclusions are accurate

Creative and ad copy are correct and approved

URLs, UTMs, and tracking are functioning properly

Identify and immediately correct errors such as incorrect creative, targeting mismatches, or tracking issues.

Maintain a zero-tolerance approach to preventable mistakes.



Tracking, Tagging & Technical Setup



Ensure proper setup and verification of pixels, tags, and tracking using tools such as Google Tag Manager and platform-specific helpers.

Confirm analytics access and tracking integrity across all assigned accounts.

Verify that all required assets and integrations are in place prior to launch or campaign changes.

Troubleshoot when tags are not firing and identify what steps need to be taken to resolve the issue.



Internal Collaboration



Work closely with Client Success Managers to execute approved campaign strategies and changes.

Receive, interpret, and act on internal campaign change requests with accuracy and urgency.

Document campaign changes and execution status clearly within internal systems.



Our requirements are pretty straightforward. To qualify you must:



Have 3–5+ years of hands-on experience managing paid media campaigns across multiple platforms.

Have direct experience with Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.

Be highly detail-oriented. You catch errors other people miss.

Be comfortable managing multiple campaigns and budgets simultaneously without losing accuracy.

Have strong organizational systems and the discipline to follow documented processes.

Be able to work in a fast-paced environment with tight turnaround times.

Have experience with campaign tracking, pixels, and analytics tools.

title: Data Analyst
description:

This role will be responsible for collecting, organizing, analyzing, and interpreting data from multiple sources to help the business understand performance, identify trends, measure results, and make better decisions.



The ideal candidate is highly proficient with spreadsheets and reporting tools, comfortable working with large amounts of data, and able to take complex information and turn it into clear, easy-to-understand insights.



You will work closely with Client Success, Marketing, Operations, and other teams to develop reporting, analyze performance, identify opportunities, and improve the way we use data across the organization.



Key Responsibilities

Data Analysis & Reporting

Collect, organize, clean, and validate data from multiple sources.

Analyze data to identify trends, patterns, opportunities, and potential issues.

Develop recurring and ad-hoc reports for internal teams and clients.

Create dashboards and reporting tools that clearly communicate performance.

Monitor key performance indicators and identify significant changes or anomalies.

Ensure reports are accurate, timely, and easy to understand.

Analyze marketing and advertising performance across multiple channels.

Review campaign, lead, conversion, traffic, and customer performance data.

Support Client Success teams with data and insights for client meetings and business reviews.

Identify trends that may impact client performance and proactively communicate findings.

Clean and standardize data from multiple platforms.

Identify duplicate, missing, or inaccurate information.

Perform data validation and quality checks.

Maintain documentation for reporting processes, data sources, and calculations.

Ensure data is consistently defined and reported across teams.

Dashboards & Automation

Build and maintain dashboards using tools such as Looker Studio, Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.

Develop advanced Excel and Google Sheets reporting systems.

Automate repetitive reporting processes whenever possible.

Identify opportunities to reduce manual data entry and reporting.

Work with internal teams to improve data collection and reporting workflows.

Business Intelligence

Provide data-driven recommendations to leadership and department heads.

Support forecasting, trend analysis, and performance planning.

Conduct root-cause analysis when performance changes unexpectedly.

Help teams understand what the data is telling us and what actions should be taken.

Develop new reports and analysis based on business needs.

Required Qualifications

2–4+ years of experience in Data Analysis, Business Intelligence, Marketing Analytics, or a related role.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Advanced Excel and/or Google Sheets skills.

Experience working with large datasets.

Experience creating reports and dashboards.

Strong attention to detail and data accuracy.

Ability to identify trends and translate data into actionable insights.

Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.

Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

Ability to work U.S. business hours.

Technical Skills



Experience with several of the following:



Microsoft Excel

Google Sheets

Looker Studio

Power BI

Tableau

SQL

Google Analytics / GA4

CRM data

Marketing platforms

Data visualization

Data cleaning and validation

Reporting automation

API or data integrations

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working with digital marketing or advertising data.

Experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO, PPC, or other digital marketing platforms.

Experience working with CRM systems.

Experience with APIs or pulling data from multiple platforms.

Basic SQL knowledge.

Experience creating client-facing reports.

Experience working with U.S.-based companies or clients.

Experience with AI tools and automation.

Experience in the home-services or advertising industry.

What Success Looks Like

Reports are accurate, timely, and easy to understand.

Teams have reliable data to make business decisions.

Client reporting is clear and actionable.

Manual reporting processes are continuously reduced through automation.

Data quality and consistency improve across the organization.

Trends and performance issues are identified before they become larger problems.

title: Sales Closer, HVAC Paid Media Agency
description:
B2B Sales Closer, HVAC Paid Media Agency



Remote | $500 Paid Trial | $1,000 Ongoing | B2B Sales



About the Agency



We are a performance-driven paid media agency specializing in helping HVAC companies generate qualified leads and booked opportunities through digital advertising.

Google Ads

Meta Ads 
 & Instagram)

TikTok Ads



We are looking for an experienced B2B Sales Closer who can take qualified sales calls, identify the prospect's needs, present the appropriate solution, overcome objections, and close the client.



This Is a Closing Position



This is NOT a cold-calling position.



You will not be responsible for spending your day prospecting hundreds of HVAC companies.



Qualified sales opportunities will be scheduled for you. Your responsibility is to run the sales call and convert qualified prospects into paying clients.



Your job is to take the call, build the case, handle objections, and close the client.



---



What You Will Be Selling



You will be selling managed paid advertising services specifically designed for HVAC companies.



Google Ads



Paid search campaigns designed to capture high-intent customers actively searching for HVAC services.



Meta Ads



 and Instagram advertising designed to generate leads and create new customer opportunities for HVAC businesses.



TikTok Ads



Paid advertising designed to expand reach, generate demand, and create additional customer acquisition opportunities.



The service is structured around an ongoing monthly paid-media management model.



---



Responsibilities



* Conduct scheduled sales calls with HVAC business owners and decision-makers

* Establish credibility and understand the prospect's business

* Identify their current lead-generation challenges

* Understand their existing advertising strategy and pain points

* Present the appropriate paid advertising solution

* Explain the value of Google Ads, Meta Ads, and TikTok Ads

* Clearly communicate the service, pricing, process, and expectations

* Handle objections regarding price, ROI, timing, existing agencies, and previous advertising experiences

* Maintain control of the sales conversation

* Ask for the sale confidently

* Close qualified prospects into recurring monthly clients

* Follow up with prospects who do not close on the initial call

* Maintain accurate sales notes and pipeline updates

* Meet established sales and revenue targets

* Provide feedback regarding lead quality and common objections



---



Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is a closer, not simply someone with general sales experience.



You should be comfortable speaking with business owners, identifying their problems, presenting solutions, handling resistance, and asking directly for the business.



Strong candidates will have:



* Proven B2B closing experience

* Experience selling marketing, advertising, SaaS, business services, or recurring services

* Experience selling to business owners or executives

* Strong phone and video-call communication skills

* Excellent objection-handling ability

* Strong consultative selling skills

* Ability to sell based on value rather than competing on price

* Ability to confidently ask for the sale

* Strong follow-up discipline

* Professional communication skills

* Competitive, results-oriented mindset

* Ability to work independently in a remote environment



HVAC Experience Is a Major Plus



Experience selling to:



* HVAC companies

* Plumbing companies

* Roofing companies

* Electrical contractors

* Home-service businesses

* Local service businesses



is highly valuable.



HVAC experience is preferred, but not required if you have a proven B2B closing track record.



---



Compensation



First Month: $500 Paid Trial



The first month is a $500 paid trial period.



The purpose of the trial is to evaluate your ability to:



* Run effective sales calls

* Build trust with business owners

* Identify prospect pain points

* Present the paid-media solution

* Handle objections

* Ask for the sale

* Close qualified opportunities

* Follow up consistently

* Generate measurable sales results

* Follow the agency's sales process



After Successful Completion: $1,000 Ongoing



After successfully completing the first-month trial, compensation increases to $1,000 ongoing.



The goal is to build a long-term relationship with a closer who can consistently convert qualified opportunities into paying HVAC clients.



Additional performance-based earning opportunities may be available as the sales operation grows.



---



What Makes This Opportunity Different



You are being hired to close.



You will not be expected to spend your day cold calling random businesses or building prospect lists.



Qualified opportunities will be scheduled for you so you can focus on what you do best:



Selling and closing.



The agency handles the paid-media fulfillment. Your responsibility is to convert qualified HVAC business owners into clients.



---



Performance Expectations



Performance will be evaluated based on:



* Sales-call quality

* Close rate

* Number of clients closed

* Revenue generated

* Follow-up conversion

* Objection handling

* Pipeline management

* Consistency

* Ability to follow the sales process



We are looking for someone who can produce measurable sales results, not someone who simply wants to take calls.



---



Who Should Apply



This position is ideal for someone who:



Knows how to close.



You understand how to conduct a sales conversation, identify a business owner's pain points, establish value, overcome objections, and confidently ask for the sale.



Experience closing marketing, advertising, SaaS, or other recurring B2B services is highly preferred.



Experience selling to HVAC or home-service businesses is a significant advantage.



---



Application Requirements



Please provide:



1. A brief summary of your B2B sales experience

2. Previous closing experience

3. Types of products or services previously sold

4. Typical deal size or monthly contract value

5. Average monthly sales volume, if applicable

6. Typical close rate, if known

7. Experience selling recurring services

8. Experience selling to business owners

9. Your availability

10. A brief response to this objection:



"Your agency is too expensive. I can find someone cheaper."



Explain how you would handle this objection during a sales call.



Serious Closers Only



This position is for someone who is confident on the phone, understands B2B sales, can handle objections, and is comfortable asking for the business.



If you are a closer who wants to sell a specialized paid advertising solution to HVAC businesses and grow with a performance-focused agency, apply.

title: 2D Animator / Rigger Needed (Long-Term, Full-Time)
description:
Illustrator/Animator/Rigger Needed — New Military History YouTube Channel.



JOB OVERVIEW



We're hiring a 2D Illustrator/Animator/Rigger for my channel, a new YouTube channel covering world military history — wars, weapons, commanders, and major conflicts — through cartoon-style storytelling. Our visual and pacing reference is Agent Flappy (137k subscribers)











 — think split-panel comparison thumbnails, bold on-screen text, and cinematic historical scenes told through a consistent cartoon art style. We're not affiliated with Agent Flappy; we're using it as a north star for the quality and tone we're building toward.



This is a ground-floor opportunity for a versatile 2D artist who can design characters and backgrounds, rig them for efficient animation, and animate scenes tightly synced to voiceover — ideally all in one person, since we're just starting out.



You'll work directly with me (the channel owner) — I'll provide scripts, voiceovers, and creative direction, and you'll design the visual world and bring it to life.



COMPENSATION & PERKS

- Typical video length: 8-10 min

- Month 1: $500 — build core character/background asset library + deliver 1 video

- Month 2 onward: $450/month for 2 videos/month, using the asset library you've built

- Retainer scales up as we move to 4 videos/month (growth path, not a fixed commitment yet)

- +5% of AdSense revenue for first 30 days on videos you co-animate

- Paid monthly

- Long-term opportunity with room to level up as the channel grows



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



1) Design & Rig Characters/Scenes

- Design characters, props, and backgrounds in Photoshop or Illustrator, matching our reference style

- Rig characters/props for efficient puppet-style animation

- Build a reusable asset library so future videos are faster to produce



2) Animate Scenes (Weekly/Bi-weekly)

- Import layered PSD files into After Effects

- Animate characters, props, and environments based on:

   - Provided storyboards

   - Voiceover timing

   - Our established animation style

- Apply motion, camera movement, transitions, and light effects as needed



3) Voiceover-Driven Timing & Pacing

- Cut and prep voiceover audio into scene segments

- Sync animation precisely to narration

- Maintain pacing consistent with high-retention YouTube content



4) Project Setup & File Management

- Organize AE projects using a defined folder structure

- Label comps and assets clearly for review and revisions



5) Weekly/Monthly Assembly & Export

- Render scenes for review

- Apply feedback and revisions

- Assemble final sequences (After Effects or Premiere)

- Export final video to channel specifications



6) Collaboration & Reliability

- Work directly with me on a set schedule

- Communicate progress and blockers early

- Hit agreed-upon delivery deadlines



THIS ROLE IS A GOOD FIT IF YOU:

- Love military history, wars, and world affairs

- Enjoy production-focused animation work

- Are comfortable animating quickly to voiceover-driven scripts

- Like working within an established cartoon visual style

- Can reliably deliver on deadline



THIS ROLE IS NOT A GOOD FIT IF YOU:

- Prefer full creative control unrelated to our reference style

- Mostly do corporate explainer videos

- Are looking for a one-off or short-term gig

- Struggle with deadlines



REQUIRED SKILLS



Must-Have:

- Strong proficiency in Adobe After Effects and Photoshop (or Illustrator)

- Ability to design original characters/backgrounds in a cartoon/vector style

- Experience rigging and animating from layered Photoshop files

- Familiarity with rigging tools (Duik, RubberHose, or similar)

- Solid understanding of timing, easing, and motion principles

- Comfortable animating to voiceover-driven scripts

- Organized workflow and clear communication



Nice-to-Have:

- Basic Premiere Pro knowledge

- Experience working on history/military-themed YouTube content

- Interest in military history, wars, weapons, and world conflicts



OUTPUT EXPECTATIONS (IMPORTANT)

- Month 1: core character/background assets + 1 completed video

- Month 2 onward: 2 completed videos per month (8-10 min each), scaling to 4/month as the channel grows

- Consistent quality matching our target style (Agent Flappy as reference)

- Ability to meet deadlines with minimal supervision



HOW TO APPLY

In your application, please include:

1. 2-3 examples of your character/background design work

2. 2-3 examples of your After Effects animation work (cartoon/explainer-style YouTube content preferred)

3. A short note on why you're interested in a ground-floor, long-term YouTube role

4. Your availability (hours/week) and timezone

5. Your rate expectations

What you'll actually do

Strategic research and recommendations. Take on major open questions (for example: what's our best path to college accreditation?). Research the landscape, weigh the options, and come back with a clear, well-argued recommendation, not just a pile of options.



Building systems and tools. Use AI tools daily to build workflows, internal systems, learning tools, and processes that make the company run better.



Working with developers. Write specs a developer can build from, review what comes back, test it carefully, and give sharp, useful feedback.



Owning curriculum and production projects. Help turn expert knowledge into world-class lessons, and build the systems that keep production running smoothly.



Taking on the "whose job is this?" projects. Some of the most important work at a growing company doesn't fit neatly into any department yet. You'll learn the domain fast and build the path forward.



What a normal week looks like:

-Driving 2 to 3 active projects at different stages

-Getting up to speed quickly on unfamiliar subjects

-Writing clear memos that turn research into decisions

-Building tools and workflows yourself, using AI

-Reviewing team and developer output and sending back precise feedback

-A short, direct check-in with the CEO: what moved, what's blocked, what needs a decision

-You can sort through a lot of information, spot what actually matters, and make a real recommendation, not just present options.

-A role that grows as fast as you do

title: Strategic Initiatives Lead to the CEO
description:
AI-First | Strategy, Technology & Special Projects

What a normal week looks like



-Driving 2 to 3 active missions at different stages

-Researching unfamiliar subjects and becoming knowledgeable quickly

-Writing recommendation memos and turning research into clear decisions

-Building tools, documents, workflows, and systems yourself using AI

-Short, direct check-ins with the CEO: what moved, what is blocked, what needs a decision



What we are looking for

1. Self-direction.

You have real examples of being handed an ambiguous goal and delivering a result on your own. This role gives you a lot of freedom, and freedom is the reward for ownership.

2. Systems thinking.

You do not just finish the work. You think about how to build the process, documentation, or system so it runs even better the next time.

3. Strong judgment.

You can sort through a lot of information, identify what actually matters, see tradeoffs, and make a thoughtful recommendation rather than simply presenting options.

4. Attention to detail.

You take pride in getting the small things right, and it shows in everything you produce, including your application.

5. Excellent written English.

Much of your output will be written: research memos, specs, documentation, instructions, feedback, and recommendations. You write clearly, precisely, and quickly.

6. AI fluency.

AI is not an occasional tool here. It is part of how we work. You already use AI tools every day to research, think, draft, build, analyze, automate, or solve problems, and you can show us real examples of how.

7. Curiosity and learning speed.

You enjoy entering a subject you know little about, asking the right questions, learning quickly, and developing enough command of it to make something useful happen.

Even better if you have



Technical fluency. You can write a spec a developer can build from, test software carefully, and build simple apps, dashboards, workflows, or automations yourself with AI tools, even without formal engineering training.



Experience as an operations lead, strategic initiatives lead, right hand to a founder, chief of staff, or founder of your own venture.

Experience owning cross-functional projects from an unclear starting point through completion.



Nice bonuses



-Instructional design or curriculum writing experience

-Real software engineering ability

-Experience working with US-based companies

-Experience building with Claude, ChatGPT, no-code tools, APIs, or AI coding tools



What you get



-Daily work directly with the CEO of a growing company

-A senior role with meaningful responsibility and visibility

-Missions with real weight. What you own truly matters to the business.

-Constant learning across education, AI, technology, operations, and business strategy

-The freedom to figure things out rather than simply execute someone else's checklist

title: QA Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Mid-Level QA Engineer with strong manual testing experience to join our team and help ensure the quality, usability, and reliability of our web-based products.



This role is ideal for someone with 3–5 years of QA experience, particularly within a web development agency, SaaS company, or fast-paced product environment.



We are looking for a QA professional who goes beyond simply following test cases. You should be naturally curious, able to think like a real user, identify edge cases and unexpected behaviors, and proactively raise issues and improvements before they reach customers.



As our QA workflow continues to evolve, you will also be expected to work comfortably with AI-assisted testing tools and modern QA practices. Automation experience is not required for this position.



Key Responsibilities



1. Manual & Exploratory Testing

• Perform comprehensive manual testing of web applications and features.

• Conduct exploratory testing to identify unexpected behaviors, usability issues, and edge cases.

• Test beyond the expected "happy path" to identify scenarios that may not have been considered during development.

• Validate new features, bug fixes, integrations, workflows, and system changes.

• Perform regression testing to ensure existing functionality remains stable after updates.

• Test across different browsers, devices, and screen sizes.

• Identify issues from both a functional and user-experience perspective.

2. Web & Mobile Application Testing

• Test responsive web applications across desktop, tablet, and mobile environments.

• Participate in testing upcoming mobile applications and mobile-specific workflows.

• Validate functionality across different devices, browsers, operating systems, and screen sizes.

• Identify UI inconsistencies, usability concerns, navigation issues, and device-specific problems.

3. Test Planning & Quality Assurance

• Review requirements, specifications, designs, and user stories to identify potential testing risks.

• Create and maintain test scenarios, test cases, checklists, and testing documentation where appropriate.

• Determine what areas require deeper testing based on the complexity and risk of a change.

• Conduct regression testing before releases.

• Verify reported bugs and confirm fixes.

• Help establish practical QA standards and processes as the team continues to improve its development workflow.

4. Bug Identification & Reporting

• Identify, document, prioritize, and communicate software defects clearly.

• Provide detailed reproduction steps, expected results, actual results, and supporting evidence.

• Work closely with developers to investigate and resolve issues.

• Retest fixes and ensure issues are properly resolved before release.

• Distinguish between critical defects, functional issues, usability concerns, and minor improvements.

5. AI-Assisted QA

• Use AI tools to improve testing efficiency, test coverage, documentation, and analysis.

• Be open to incorporating AI into day-to-day QA workflows.

• Work alongside emerging AI-assisted and Playwright-based testing processes.

• Identify opportunities where AI can improve testing without compromising quality or critical thinking.

• Maintain ownership of QA decisions rather than relying blindly on automated or AI-generated results.

6. Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

• Work closely with developers, product stakeholders, and other team members throughout the development lifecycle.

• Communicate issues and risks clearly and constructively.

• Ask questions when requirements or expected behavior are unclear.

• Proactively suggest improvements to product quality, testing processes, and user experience.

• Follow through on identified issues until they are appropriately resolved.

• Contribute to a collaborative, communicative, and quality-focused team environment.



What We're Looking For



Required Qualifications

• 3–5 years of professional QA/testing experience.

• Strong experience in manual software testing.

• Experience testing web applications.

• Experience in a web development agency, SaaS company, or similar fast-paced technology environment.

• Experience with functional, regression, exploratory, and cross-browser testing.

• Experience testing responsive web applications across different devices and screen sizes.

• Strong ability to identify edge cases and unexpected user scenarios.

• Strong attention to detail without losing sight of the overall user experience.

• Ability to work independently and manage testing priorities with limited supervision.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Comfortable working with developers and other technical team members.

• Willingness to learn and use AI-assisted QA tools and modern testing workflows.



Nice to Have

• Experience testing mobile applications.

• Experience working with SaaS products.

• Understanding of common SaaS concepts such as:

        - User roles and permissions

        - Multi-tenancy

        - User workflows

        - Integrations

        - Authentication and authorization

        - Data dependencies

• Basic understanding of APIs and API testing.

• Familiarity with browser developer tools.

• Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Linear, ClickUp, GitHub, or similar project/issue-tracking platforms.

• Exposure to Playwright or other test automation frameworks.

• Basic understanding of SQL/database validation.



Why join us

You'll work directly with businesses to help modernize their operations through one of the fastest-growing cloud ERP platforms, while contributing to implementation, optimization, and transformation projects.



How to apply

Please fill up our application form using the link below to apply

title: Reverse Recruiter | Career Services | Customer Support
description:
Career Services Coordinator (Virtual Assistant)



We run an AI-powered platform that automatically matches and applies to jobs on behalf of job seekers. The platform works best when there's strong alignment between a client's resume, their job titles, and the roles they're targeting. When that alignment is right, clients are getting 5-10 interviews per month. When it's off, the tool underperforms. This role is responsible for getting that alignment right.



What you'll do:



Resume Analysis (following our framework):

- Compare each client's resume headline, job titles, and skills against their target role list

- Flag mismatches: titles that don't exist in the market, headlines that claim experience not supported by the resume, internal titles that recruiters won't search for

- Document findings in a standard template



Platform Expertise and Job Market Verification:

- Become an expert in our platform and use it as the primary tool for verifying whether target roles are available and being matched correctly

- Provide feedback when the platform is missing roles or returning poor matches

- Use external job boards (LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor) when needed to confirm whether a role is missing from our platform or is uncommon in the market



New Client Intake and Ongoing Maintenance:

- Proactively check for new client accounts and begin analysis without waiting to be assigned

- Monitor existing client accounts to ensure alignment stays current as job markets shift

- Volume varies by day, from a handful of reviews up to 30



Recommendation Drafts:

- Prepare a summary of recommended changes: titles to add, titles to remove, resume edits needed

- Draft client-facing messages for review before sending

- Once approved, execute changes to resumes and search configurations

- Flag clients where we may not be a good fit for their target roles rather than forcing recommendations that won't work. Escalate these internally



Coach Communication (after ramp-up):

- Present recommendations to career coaches who manage client relationships. These coaches are experienced professionals who expect you to know the job market and back up your recommendations with evidence

- Answer follow-up questions about title changes and resume edits

- Ask for internal support when a client's industry or role is outside your knowledge area



Required:



- Excellent written English. Your writing goes directly to US-based clients and experienced career coaches. This is non-negotiable

- 2+ years in recruiting, HR, resume review, career services, or talent acquisition

- Ability to follow a defined process consistently, even on high-volume days

- Comfortable doing online research when needed to verify job availability

- Proactive work style. You'll be checking for new clients and monitoring accounts, not waiting for tasks to be assigned

- Available during US business hours for at least 4 hours of overlap



Nice to have (we can teach these quickly):



- Proficiency with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity). We'll train you on how to use these for research and drafting

- Familiarity with US job titles, hiring norms, and how ATS systems work. We have reference materials and frameworks for this

- Knowledge of specific industries. Our process and templates will guide you through unfamiliar sectors

- Resume formatting and document editing. Helpful but not the core skill

- Experience with specific job boards. Only used for spot-checking, not primary workflow



This role starts with all work reviewed before it reaches clients. As you demonstrate consistent quality, you'll take on more direct coach and client communication.



Remote. ~$1,000 /month, depending on experience + Bonuses.

title: Full-Time React / Remotion Developer for AI Video Platform
description:
We’re hiring one full-time developer to help turn a working internal AI video tool into a reliable production platform.



The tool takes scripts and voiceovers, generates and selects visuals, then renders complete long-form videos that can be 2–3 hours long. The core rendering layer uses Remotion and React and connects to several external APIs. It already works and is being used in production. We now need to make it faster, more reliable and capable of handling more visual formats.



You will be the main day-to-day builder. A separate senior developer will review architecture and important code, so you will have technical support without being micromanaged.



WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON



- React, TypeScript, Node.js and Remotion development

- Long-running video render jobs, queues, retries and checkpointing

- FFmpeg and other media-processing work

- API and AI-model integrations

- Cloud storage and production deployments

- Fixing bugs and reducing manual work

- Improving render speed, cost and reliability

- Building new production features from clear acceptance criteria

- Tests, documentation and clean GitHub pull requests



WHAT WE NEED



- Strong React, TypeScript and Node.js ability

- Experience with Remotion, FFmpeg or programmatic video generation is a major advantage

- Experience with APIs, asynchronous jobs and production systems

- Evidence that you have personally shipped real software

- Strong debugging skills

- Fast, clear communication and reliable daily availability

- Ability to work independently, raise blockers early and explain trade-offs

- Comfortable using AI coding tools, while still verifying and understanding everything you ship

- Able to commit 40 hours per week long term



PAY AND PROCESS



- $800–$1,000 USD per month to start, depending on ability

- Paid 8-hour practical trial using a small, clearly defined task

- Four-week initial proving period

- Performance and salary review after 60 days

- Long-term role for someone who consistently ships good work quickly



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word REMOTION so I know you read the full post.



Then answer these questions in order:



1. Link 2–3 live products, repositories or relevant projects you personally built. Explain exactly what you did on each.

2. What experience do you have with Remotion, FFmpeg or video/media pipelines?

3. Describe the hardest production bug you personally diagnosed and fixed.

4. Which AI coding tools do you use, and how do you verify the code they produce?

5. What is your exact weekly availability and time zone?

6. What monthly salary are you asking for within the listed range?

7. Confirm whether you can commit 40 hours per week and disclose any other ongoing jobs or clients.

8. In 3–5 sentences: if a three-hour video render fails at 92%, how would you design the system so it does not restart from zero?



Generic applications that do not answer every question will not be considered.

You'll own video across three areas: short-form Meta ad creative that stops the scroll, landing page and website video that builds trust with parents, and long-form content (school tours, testimonials, VSLs) that tells a school's story.



This isn't a seat-filler role. We want someone who pairs genuine craft with speed, uses AI to multiply their output without sacrificing quality, and takes full ownership of what they ship.

- Edit high-volume, high-quality short-form video ads for Meta 
/Instagram Reels, Stories, Feed)

- Produce multiple hooks, lengths, and aspect ratios per concept so we can test what wins

- Use AI tools throughout your workflow — transcription, captioning, voiceover, b-roll generation, upscaling, sound cleanup — to work faster and explore more directions

- Add motion graphics, captions, and text overlays designed for sound-off viewing

- Translate campaign goals and audience insights into video that performs, not just looks good

- Maintain brand consistency across every asset and client

- Review performance data with the team and iterate on what's working

### What You Bring

- A portfolio that immediately makes the case — short-form ad creative, testimonials, or brand video that's both polished and conversion-minded

.
