title: SENIOR PROJECT MANAGER
description:
WORDPRESS & MARKETING AGENCY — REMOTE

Senior Project Manager Role



Location: Remote

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Central Time

Salary: $2,352 USD per month



ABOUT THE ROLE

The Mighty Mo! Design Co. is hiring a full-time Senior Project Manager to manage WordPress, website, support, and SEO projects from start to finish.



You will own project status, tasks, deadlines, budgets, client communication, team coordination, QA, and follow-through. You should always know what needs to happen next, who owns it, whether the project is on track, and what needs to be escalated.



We need someone proactive, highly organized, comfortable leading client calls, and capable of identifying and solving problems without constant supervision.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. PROJECT OWNERSHIP

- Manage multiple WordPress, website, support, and SEO projects.

- Understand contracts, scope, priorities, deadlines, and budgets

- Translate requests into clear tasks, owners, deadlines, and acceptance criteria.

- Keep project-management systems accurate and up to date, including tasks, deadlines, priorities, and project status.

- Proactively follow up on blocked or overdue work and keep projects moving toward completion.



2. TIMELINE, SCOPE, AND BUDGET

- Track progress, hours, and budgets against estimates

- Identify scope changes and risks early

- Flag potential delays or budget issues before they become problems

- Escalate issues with clear options and recommendations



3. CLIENT COMMUNICATION

- Lead client communication by
, phone, and video

- Explain project status, timelines, responsibilities, and next steps clearly

- Do your research, then ask direct, thoughtful questions when a request is unclear

- Set realistic expectations around timing, scope, and deliverables

- Handle difficult conversations professionally

- Send clear recaps after important calls

- Respond to client questions within 1 business day

- Excellent spoken English is required.



4. TEAM COORDINATION

- Coordinate developers, designers, SEO specialists, and other team members.

- Ensure tasks and handoffs contain the necessary context.

- Follow up when commitments are missed and clarify priorities.



5. QUALITY ASSURANCE

- Review and test work before presenting it to clients.

- Confirm deliverables meet requirements and acceptance criteria.

- Check website changes across relevant devices and browsers.

- Identify incomplete, broken, or missing work and confirm corrections.

You do not need to be a developer, but you must be comfortable reviewing websites carefully.



DAILY AND WEEKLY EXPECTATIONS



Daily

- Be online and responsive from 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Central

- Submit a daily status report describing what you completed that day, blockers, and what you’ll complete the next day

- Review projects, tasks, deadlines, and communication

- Follow up on overdue or blocked work

- Keep project-management systems updated

- Communicate urgent risks or delays as soon as they are identified

- Track time accurately

- Ensure developer workloads align with capacity



Weekly

- Review the health of every assigned project

- Update timelines, priorities, tasks, and budgets

- Identify projects that are on track, at risk, or off track

- Prepare project updates and confirm clients know what is complete, next, and needed from them.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND ABILITIES

- Excellent spoken and written English

- Experience managing multiple projects, deadlines, and team members

- Confident leading client calls

- Strong organization, prioritization, and attention to detail

- Proactive problem-solving and risk identification

- Comfortable holding teammates accountable

- Able to work independently

- Reliable internet, professional workspace, and dependable availability



STRONGLY PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

- 5+ years of project-management experience

- WordPress, web development, SEO, or marketing agency experience

- Experience with project management tools such as ClickUp

- Familiarity with hosting, domains, plugins, WooCommerce, SEO, and QA is a plus

- Experience tracking budgets or estimated vs. actual hours



THIS ROLE IS PROBABLY NOT A FIT IF YOU:

- Wait for updates instead of proactively seeking them

- Avoid difficult conversations

- Depend on a manager to identify problems

- Lose track of commitments or client requests

- Need detailed instructions before taking action

- Are uncomfortable with budgets, timelines, contracts, or task details

- Want to work another full-time job during these hours



HOW TO APPLY

Submit:

1. Your resume detailing your specific project management experiences

2. A short cover letter

3. A two- to three-minute video (Loom or similar - see details below)



In Your Video, Answer:

- Why are you interested in this position?

- What project-management responsibilities have you personally owned?

- How comfortable are you leading client calls?

- Tell us about a time you handled a missed commitment or difficult client issue.



Please do not use AI-generated answers. We want to understand how you personally think and communicate. Applicants who advance will discuss their answers during a live interview. Every complete application is reviewed personally by our hiring manager.



IMPORTANT

We need more than a personable communicator. We need someone who combines strong communication with operational discipline—someone who tracks commitments, follows up, identifies risks early, and takes ownership of moving projects forward.



If that sounds like you, we would like to hear from you.

title: AI Automations and Systems Specialist
description:
AI Agents, Process Improvement & Product Innovation



$8–$12 USD/hour depending on experience

Part-Time to Start | Approximately 20 Hours Per Week

Remote | Long-Term Opportunity



About Quickpage

Quickpage is a U.S.-based SaaS company that helps sales teams use personalized video and digital sales experiences to connect with customers, build trust, improve appointment show rates, and close more business.

We work with sales organizations across industries including home improvement, automotive, RV, and other appointment-driven businesses.



We believe AI is going to create major opportunities both inside our company and within our product.

The challenge is that we don't want to simply automate what we already know.

We want someone who can help us discover what we don't know is possible yet.



The Role

We are looking for an experienced AI Automation & Systems Specialist who can study how Quickpage operates, identify opportunities for AI and automation, and help us build better systems.



This is not a role where we will hand you a list of automations and ask you to build them.



We want someone who will look at our processes and say:

"Why are you doing it this way?"

"AI could handle this."

"These systems should be connected."

"Here's something you could build that you may not have considered."

You should enjoy learning how a business works, finding inefficiencies, experimenting with new AI technology, and turning ideas into working solutions.



Your Two Main Areas of Focus

Improve How Quickpage Operates Internally

You will work with our leadership, sales, customer success, marketing, support, and development teams to identify repetitive or inefficient processes.



Examples could include:

• Automating prospect and company research before sales calls

• Using AI to prepare sales reps for upcoming demos

• Analyzing sales calls and identifying objections, patterns, and opportunities

• Automatically creating tasks and follow-ups from meetings

• Identifying CRM opportunities that are becoming stale

• Monitoring customer adoption and account health

• Finding customer wins and potential case studies automatically

• Turning meetings and customer conversations into marketing content

• Building AI-assisted SOPs and internal knowledge systems

• Improving customer onboarding processes

• Connecting systems through APIs, webhooks, and automations

• Building AI agents that complete repetitive tasks for our team



We want you to constantly look for opportunities to save time, improve decision-making, and make our team more effective.



Identify AI Opportunities Inside the Quickpage Product



We also want you to study the Quickpage application itself and work with our leadership and development team to identify ways AI could make our product significantly better.



Possible ideas could include:

• AI-generated customer messaging

• Automatically creating personalized Quickpages from CRM information

• AI-generated FAQs based on the customer's project

• AI-assisted video scripts for salespeople

• Intelligent content and template recommendations

• Customer engagement and buying-intent scoring

• AI-powered follow-up recommendations

• Automatically summarizing customer activity for sales reps

• AI chat agents that answer customer questions using approved company information

• Personalized content based on customer type, industry, project, or sales stage

• Analyzing successful Quickpages to identify what top-performing salespeople do differently

• AI coaching for salesperson videos, messaging, calls to action, and content



These are only examples.

One of the main reasons we are hiring this position is because we want you to bring us ideas we haven't thought of yet.



What We're Looking For

You should have hands-on experience with several of the following:

• AI agents and AI workflows

• OpenAI / ChatGPT APIs

• Claude and other major AI models

• n8n

• Make

• Zapier

• APIs and webhooks

• CRM automation

• AI-assisted coding tools such as Cursor or Claude Code

• Connecting multiple software platforms together

• Prompt design and structured AI workflows

• Building internal tools or AI-powered applications



You do not need to be a traditional software engineer.



However, you should be technical enough to understand systems, APIs, automation, and how AI tools can be connected to solve real business problems.



More Important Than the Tools

We care a lot about how you think.



We are looking for someone who is:

• Extremely curious

• Proactive

• Resourceful

• Comfortable experimenting

• Able to work independently

• Business-minded, not just technical

• Constantly learning about new AI capabilities

• Willing to challenge existing processes

• Able to explain complicated ideas simply

• Capable of taking an idea from concept to working prototype



If your preferred working style is waiting for someone to tell you exactly what to build, this probably isn't the right position.

If you naturally look at systems and think "there has to be a better way to do this," we would like to talk with you.



Compensation

$8–$12 USD/hour depending on experience and capability

We expect to start at approximately 20 hours per week.



For the right person, there is an opportunity for increased hours, responsibility, compensation, and a long-term role with Quickpage.



We are more interested in finding the right person than hiring the cheapest person.



How to Apply

Record a short video introducing yourself and explaining why you think you'd be a good fit for this role and complete the application form found on the Quickpage here: 



WHEN YOU ARE DONE, PLEASE REPLY TO THIS JOB POST SAYING THAT YOU HAVE COMPLETED THE APPLICATION



Most Important Part of the Application

Spend some time researching Quickpage and what our product does.

We want to understand how you think.

Generic AI-generated applications that do not demonstrate original thinking will not be considered.

title: Accounts Receivable & Collections Professional
description:
Position Summary



We are looking for an experienced Accounts Receivable & Collections Professional to take ownership of the accounts receivable process for a U.S.-based home services company.



This is primarily an accounting and accounts receivable role that also requires regular communication with customers regarding outstanding balances. We are not looking for a traditional call-center collections specialist. We want someone who understands AR, is comfortable working in accounting systems, has strong attention to detail, and can communicate professionally and naturally with customers.



The right person will help manage the AR process from invoicing and payment tracking through collections, reconciliation, and month-end close.



Key Responsibilities



* Manage the day-to-day accounts receivable process

* Prepare, review, and enter customer invoices accurately

* Apply and track customer payments

* Review AR aging reports and identify past-due accounts requiring follow-up

* Contact customers regarding outstanding invoices by phone and

* Handle collections conversations in a friendly, professional manner while maintaining positive customer relationships

* Research payment discrepancies and help resolve billing issues

* Process or assist with credit memos, refunds, payment adjustments, and other AR transactions

* Reconcile accounts receivable records and investigate differences

* Maintain accurate documentation of payment status, customer communication, and collection activity

* Assist with closing the AR side of the books each month

* Communicate proactively with the finance team regarding problem accounts, discrepancies, and recurring issues

* Support the CFO and accounting team with other AR-related responsibilities as needed



Required Qualifications



* Minimum 3 years of relevant accounts receivable, accounting, or bookkeeping experience supporting U.S.-based companies

* Hands-on QuickBooks Online experience

* Working knowledge of the full accounts receivable cycle, including invoicing, payments, AR aging, collections, credit memos, and reconciliations

* Comfortable making outbound phone calls regarding outstanding customer balances

* Strong written and spoken English

* Strong attention to detail and ability to work accurately with financial information

* Comfortable learning and working in multiple software systems

* Able to work independently and take ownership of assigned responsibilities

* College degree

* Reliable high-speed internet connection and dedicated, distraction-free workspace

* Able to work full-time during U.S. Eastern business hours



BONUS - Move to the Front of the Line



* Experience working with home services companies such as HVAC, plumbing, electrical, or similar trades

* Experience working directly with a U.S.-based finance or accounting department

* Experience working remotely during U.S. business hours

* Experience with ServiceTitan is a major plus

* Experience reconciling AR between an operational system and QuickBooks Online



What We're Looking For



We want someone who combines accounting ability with strong communication skills.



Most collection conversations in this role are not aggressive collection calls. Our customers are homeowners, and in many cases an unpaid invoice simply requires a friendly reminder or help resolving a billing issue.



You should be comfortable picking up the phone, building rapport with customers, asking for payment professionally, and following through until an issue is resolved.



At the same time, you need to be comfortable working with numbers, investigating discrepancies, following accounting processes, and making sure the AR records are accurate.



Schedule & Logistics



* Full-time, 40 hours per week

* Fully remote

* Must work U.S. Eastern business hours

* This should be your primary full-time position

* Training will be provided, including recorded Zoom training and documented procedures



How to Apply



Please include all three of the following with your application:



1. Your current resume

2. A 1-minute video introduction explaining your accounts receivable/accounting experience and why you believe you would be a good fit for this position

3. Confirmation that you are available to work full-time during U.S. Eastern business hours



In your application, please also tell us:



* How many years of hands-on QuickBooks Online experience you have

* What AR responsibilities you have personally handled

* Whether you have experience making collection calls to U.S. customers

* Whether you have ever used ServiceTitan



Applications that do not include a resume, 1-minute video introduction, and confirmation of U.S. Eastern-hours availability will not be considered.

title: Operations Director
description:
About ExitPath Partners, LLC. 



ExitPath Partners is an M&A advisory firm built around a single vertical: law firms. We represent retiring and exiting firm owners on the sell side, and acquisition-minded firm owners on the buy-side, including private equity platforms, strategic law firm buyers, and individual operators.



THE OPPORTUNITY

We are seeking a true operator, a doer that owns the firm’s operating discipline: the cadence, the pipeline data, the paper trail, and the follow-through on all firm projects. If you have ever been the person who made an operating system stick inside a founder-led business, this is that job.



WHAT YOU’LL OWN

1.  The operating cadence. - Leadership and department meetings ran, held, and recorded. Agendas distributed, scorecards fully populated before and every assigned task and priority tied to a company initiative and quarterly goal.

2.  Pipeline operations integrity. - CRM hygiene and stage velocity as a managed system: a current interaction logged on every active deal, stage violations surfaced automatically, and stale inventory driven down. 

3.  Team coordination and capacity protection. - Task closure tracked and enforced. Capacity limits are accessed and honored. No critical function left with a single point of failure and no backup. We’re building to scale and you’ll be responsible for redundancy implementation.

4.  Leadership optimization - Every new “yes” logged alongside the “no” it displaces. Priority changes announced in the room and rather than absorbed quietly. A monthly compliance report that lands on the founders’ desks without anyone asking for it.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



Must have:

• 5+ years running operations in a professional services, advisory, private equity, or law firm environment

• Chief of staff, director of operations, practice manager, or business manager

• Direct experience running an operating cadence (EOS/Traction, 4DX, OKRs, or a homegrown equivalent). 

• Documentation and process discipline 

• Working command of a deal or relationship CRM and comfort administering data standards 

•       U.S. Eastern time or a good portion of your hours aligned with our working time zone.



Helpful, not required:

• Law firm or legal services operations background

• Exposure to M&A transaction process, deal desk, or contract administration

• Experience inside a partner-led business



No JD or bar admission is required or expected. This is an operations seat, not a legal one.



WHO THIS ROLE ISN’T FOR



We would rather be direct now than waste your time in a fourth interview.

• If you want to redesign the operating system rather than run it week after week, you will be bored here.

• If you disengage when people don’t comply and let the system do the confronting for you, this role will fail.

• If the appeal is a path into origination or deal execution, that is not on offer.

• If a job whose central function is enforcing consistency sounds tedious to you, trust that instinct.

title: Video Editor/Social Media Manager
description:
# Part-Time Video Editor — Short-Form + Carousels (Credit/Finance Content)



**Company:** Upper Echelon Capital

**Type:** Part-time, independent contractor

**Hours:** ~3 hours/day (~15–18 hrs/week), flexible schedule, deadline-driven not clock-in

**Pay:** $50/week (flat weekly rate)

**Location:** Remote / Philippines



## About the Role



Upper Echelon Capital is a U.S. business credit, credit repair, and business funding consulting company. We're rebuilding our content presence across Instagram, YouTube Shorts, and TikTok and need an editor to turn raw talking-head recordings into polished short-form video and carousels every week — on a consistent schedule.



You won't be filming or scripting. I record the raw video myself covering credit repair, credit building, and business funding topics. Your job is everything after that: cutting it down, captioning it, making it scroll-stopping, and formatting it for each platform.



## Weekly Deliverables



- **3 short-form videos/week** — cut from my raw recordings, ≤60 seconds, vertical 9:16, exported and formatted for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and TikTok (platform-specific caption placement/safe zones)

- **2 Instagram carousels/week** — 6–10 slide static or light-motion carousels built from bullet points/scripts I provide, on-brand with UEC's colors/fonts

- **1 long-form YouTube video/week** — a longer edit (5–15 min) from extended raw footage, with a custom thumbnail



## What Each Piece Needs



- Hook in the first 2–3 seconds, burned-in captions, clean cuts (no dead air), on-screen text call-outs for key points

- Following our **70/20/10 content mix**: most weeks should land close to

  - **70% Value** — educational credit repair, credit building, and business funding content people save/share

  - **20% Proof** — client results, before/after credit scores, testimonial clips, case-study breakdowns

  - **10% Offer** — direct CTA content pointing to our services (Expedited Credit Repair, Elite Credit Repair, Elite Mentorship, Platinum Mentorship)

- Simple intro/outro and logo watermark, consistent across all posts

- Carousels follow the same ratio — mostly value-driven checklists/breakdowns, occasional proof or offer slide sets



## Suggested Weekly Rhythm (starting point — flexible)



| Day | Deliverable | Type |

|---|---|---|

| Mon | Short-form video #1 | Value |

| Tue | Carousel #1 | Value |

| Wed | Short-form video #2 | Value or Proof |

| Thu | Carousel #2 | Value or Proof |

| Fri | Short-form video #3 | Proof or Offer |

| Weekly | Long-form YouTube video | Value (expanded) |



## Requirements



- Proven experience editing short-form vertical video (CapCut, Premiere Pro, or DaVinci Resolve)

- Experience designing Instagram carousels (Canva or Photoshop)

- Strong accurate English captioning/subtitling

- Understanding of Reels/TikTok/Shorts pacing, hooks, and trends

- Reliable with deadlines and clear async communication (WhatsApp/Slack/Trello)

- Must submit a portfolio or sample edits with application



## Schedule & Pay



- Part-time, ~3 hrs/day — you manage your own hours as long as weekly deliverables are met on schedule

- $50/week flat rate, paid weekly

- Growth potential: rate and scope can increase as output and results scale



## How to Apply



Please reply with:

1. Your portfolio or 2–3 sample short-form edits / carousels (finance, business, or education niche preferred but not required)

2. What editing software you use

3. Your available hours (time zone + daily availability)



**Screening question (recommended for the OnlineJobs.ph post):** "Edit down this 3-minute raw clip [link] into a 45-second vertical Reel with captions and send it back with your application." Filters for follow-through before you interview anyone.

title: Part-Time UGC and Short-Form Ad Video Editor
description:
Part-Time UGC and Short-Form Ad Video Editor



I’m looking for a skilled short-form video editor who understands UGC-style content and knows how to turn raw footage into fast-paced, engaging ads for Instagram
 and other Meta placements.



I currently create between 100 and 200 videos per month for multiple companies, and I want to increase that output by outsourcing much of the editing. This will begin as a part-time position requiring approximately four hours per day, with the potential to grow into a larger or full-time role.



I work in the Pacific Time zone, so you should be available for some overlap with normal working hours in PT. You do not necessarily need to live in the same time zone, but communication and turnaround times should align with my schedule.



What You’ll Be Doing



Editing short-form UGC and talking-head and b-roll advertisements

Removing pauses, dead space, filler and unnecessary footage

Tightening the pacing so every video feels concise and engaging

Adding clean, accurate and visually appealing captions

Using punch-ins, punch-outs and scale keyframing to create movement

Adding pattern interrupts, B-roll, graphics and sound effects when appropriate

Emphasizing hooks, important statements and calls to action

Creating polished ads that will run through Meta for multiple companies

Following brand-specific examples and maintaining consistent editing styles

Managing revisions through a simple, organized feedback process

Uploading approved videos to my Trybe account

Organizing projects and delivering videos on schedule

Handling a relatively high volume of short-form content

Feedback and Communication



I want the review process to be as simple and efficient as possible. Ideally, you already use a video-review platform such as 
, Dropbox Replay, Vimeo Review or another tool that allows me to leave time-stamped comments directly on each video.



Please mention the review and feedback software you currently use when applying. If you have a better system for managing a high volume of edits and revisions, I’m open to your recommendations.



Our primary day-to-day communication will be through WhatsApp, so you must be comfortable communicating consistently and professionally there.



Once a video has been reviewed and approved, you will be responsible for uploading the finished version to my Trybe account and ensuring the correct file is properly labeled and organized.



Who I’m Looking For



You should:



Have experience editing UGC, TikTok, Instagram Reels or short-form advertisements

Understand direct-response advertising and retention-focused editing

Know how to capture attention within the first few seconds

Have excellent instincts for pacing, timing and removing dead space

Know how to use captions, keyframes and visual changes without making videos feel over-edited

Be comfortable adapting videos for different brands, products and audiences

Be able to follow an established style while contributing creative ideas

Be dependable, organized and comfortable working with a high volume of content

Communicate clearly and respond well to feedback

Be available for approximately four hours per weekday

Have some working-hour overlap with the Pacific Time zone

Be comfortable using WhatsApp as the primary communication channel

Be able to upload and organize approved videos in Trybe

Experience editing direct-response ads or performance-marketing content for Meta is strongly preferred.



Editing Style



I’m looking for clean, modern and engaging editing. I do not want unnecessary effects everywhere. The goal is to make the speaker feel natural while keeping the viewer’s attention through:



Strong opening hooks

Tight cuts

Fast, natural pacing

Strategic punch-ins and punch-outs

Accurate captions

Relevant B-roll and graphics

Subtle sound design

Effective visual pattern interrupts

Clear calls to action

Some green screen effects



Because these videos will be used as paid advertisements, each editing decision should help improve clarity, viewer retention and conversion rather than simply making the video look flashy.



To Apply

Please send:



A brief introduction and your location/time zone

Links to three examples of UGC or short-form ads you edited

Examples of any Meta ads you have edited

The editing software you use

The video-review or feedback platform you use

Your typical turnaround time

Your monthly rate/per video rate

Your approximate daily availability in Pacific Time

A short explanation of how you make a talking-head video more engaging

Confirmation that you are comfortable communicating through WhatsApp and uploading approved videos to Trybe

Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a brief paid editing test using the same raw footage. This will help evaluate pacing, captions, creative judgment, communication and overall fit.

title: VIRTUAL MARKETPLACE DEAL SPECIALIST
description:
Deal Finding • Online Flipping •
 Marketplace • Sales • Research • AI



WE ARE HIRING 2 PEOPLE—READ THIS ENTIRE POSTING BEFORE APPLYING.



We are starting at ground zero to build a virtual flipping business and looking for TWO hungry, resourceful, profit-driven virtual assistants who want an opportunity to grow with a business rather than simply complete tasks.



This is NOT a traditional VA/data-entry position.



We are looking for people who think like deal hunters, researchers, negotiators, and salespeople.



Your job is simple to understand:



FIND OPPORTUNITIES. CREATE DEALS. GENERATE PROFIT.



We will provide the systems, technology, training, and some scripts.



You bring the hustle, judgment, communication skills, creativity, and desire to make money.



WHAT WE DO



We are building a technology-assisted virtual flipping operation.



Our AI-powered scraping system will identify potential opportunities from online marketplaces and classified websites such as Craigslist, OfferUp,
 Marketplace, and similar platforms.



We will pursue two primary types of opportunities.



LOW-TICKET FLIPS



Examples include:



Couches • Furniture • TVs • Electronics • Appliances • Watches • Tools • Exercise Equipment • Household Items • Free Items



Our system may identify something being given away FREE or sold significantly below its potential resale value.



Your job is to determine:



Is there actually money here?



You may research comparable items, determine realistic resale value, improve the listing, communicate with buyers/sellers, and help move the opportunity toward an actual sale.



HIGH-TICKET OPPORTUNITIES



We will also pursue:



Cars • Trucks • Motorcycles • Boats • RVs • ATVs • Trailers • Equipment and other valuable assets.



Depending on the opportunity and applicable rules, the business may pursue an authorized referral/finder arrangement, negotiated spread, or other appropriate transaction structure.



You must never misrepresent ownership, possession, title status, or our authority regarding an item.



THE AI FINDS LEADS. YOU FIND THE MONEY.



We already have technology designed to help identify potential listings.



We are NOT hiring you to manually scroll through websites for eight hours per day.



The system helps generate possibilities.



Your value is what happens AFTER the lead appears.



You will evaluate opportunities and ask questions such as:



What is this actually worth?

Is the asking price really below market?

What are comparable items selling for?

How quickly could we realistically sell it?

Is there enough margin?

Is this worth our time?

What information is missing?

What could kill the deal?

How should we market it?

Who is the likely buyer?

Should we negotiate?

How can we turn this lead into PROFIT?



We want someone who eventually sees opportunities that the system itself missed.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Your responsibilities may include:



Reviewing leads generated by our AI scraper

Researching realistic resale values

Finding comparable listings

Calculating potential margins

Identifying the strongest opportunities

Ranking and prioritizing deals

Researching products, vehicles, and other assets

Verifying listing information

Improving titles and descriptions

Preparing
 Marketplace listings

Monitoring active listings

Adjusting pricing and strategy

Responding to buyer and seller messages

Following up with interested prospects

Negotiating within approved guidelines

Tracking leads and deals

Maintaining accurate records

Flagging scams and suspicious opportunities

Finding creative ways to get slow-moving inventory sold

Reporting what is working and what isn't

Helping improve our process as we learn



Most importantly:



YOU ARE EXPECTED TO ACTIVELY HELP TURN OPPORTUNITIES INTO PROFIT.



YES — YOU MUST BE COMFORTABLE TALKING TO PEOPLE



This position is NOT text-only.



You must be comfortable communicating with people through:



Phone calls • Voice drops/messages • Text/chat •
 • Marketplace messaging



We will provide scripts for many situations.



However, real conversations don't always follow scripts.



Sometimes a seller is going to ask something unexpected.



Sometimes a buyer needs reassurance.



Sometimes you need to negotiate.



Sometimes you simply need to have a normal human-to-human conversation.



If you are uncomfortable speaking with people, making calls, leaving voice messages, following up, or having unscripted conversations in English, this position is probably not for you.



You do NOT need a perfect American accent.



You DO need to communicate clearly, confidently, professionally, and naturally.



WE ARE LOOKING FOR ENTREPRENEURS — NOT TASK CHECKERS



This is extremely important.



We do NOT want someone whose mindset is:



“I posted my listings. My work is finished.”



Posting something does not make the business money.



Selling it does.



If something isn't selling, we expect you to think:



Should we change the price?



Should we improve the photos?



Should we rewrite the title?



Should we change the description?



Should we target a different buyer?



Should we follow up with previous inquiries?



Should we pursue another platform?



What can we learn from competing listings?



What else can we do to MOVE THIS DEAL?



We want people who naturally think:



“What can I do to help turn this into money?”



60-DAY PROFITABILITY TRIAL



The first 60 days are a trial period.



During those 60 days, we will build the operation together, test strategies, improve our systems, learn which categories perform best, and determine whether you can consistently contribute to profitable transactions.



We understand that building a new operation takes time.



We are NOT expecting magic on Day 1.



But we ARE expecting urgency.



By the end of the 60-day period, we need to see clear evidence that the operation — and your individual contribution to it — can produce profit.



Simply logging in, posting listings, completing assigned tasks, and collecting a paycheck will not be enough.



We are looking for people who want to BUILD something.



COMPENSATION & PROFIT-SHARING



Starting Base Pay: $200 USD biweekly



The base salary provides guaranteed starting compensation while we build and test the operation.



But the base salary is NOT where we want your income to stop.



Our objective is to create a profitable operation where performance becomes considerably more valuable than base pay.



Once the business reaches the defined profitability threshold, each team member may earn approximately:



10%–15% OF ELIGIBLE GROSS PROFIT



Final percentages, qualifying transactions, calculation methods, and payment rules will be documented as part of the compensation plan.



The long-term business target is:



$10,000–$20,000+ MONTHLY PROFIT



That will not happen overnight, and it is NOT a promise or guarantee of earnings.



It is the target we are building toward.



As the business becomes profitable, the goal is for strong performers to have significantly more upside through performance compensation than they would receive from base salary alone.



We want your financial interests aligned with ours.



When the business makes more money because of your contribution, we want you to have the opportunity to make more money too.



WHO WILL SUCCEED HERE?



You may be a great fit if you are:



HUNGRY — You want more than a basic VA position.



RESOURCEFUL — When you don't know something, you figure it out.



PROFIT-MINDED — You understand that activity and results are different things.



PERSISTENT — One unanswered message doesn't mean the lead is dead.



A RESEARCHER — You can investigate an item and determine what it is realistically worth.



COMFORTABLE WITH PEOPLE — You can communicate by phone, voice, chat, and
.



TECH-SAVVY — You are comfortable learning AI tools and new systems.



INDEPENDENT — Once trained, you don't need someone watching you every minute.



CREATIVE — If Strategy A isn't working, you start thinking about Strategy B.



ORGANIZED — Leads, buyers, sellers, follow-ups, prices, and transactions must be tracked accurately.



COACHABLE — We are building this system together and will constantly improve it.



EXPERIENCE THAT WILL GET OUR ATTENTION



Experience with any of these is helpful:



 Marketplace • Craigslist • OfferUp • eBay • Mercari • Online Arbitrage • Reselling • Marketplace Selling • Lead Generation • Product Research • Vehicle Research • Used-Car Sales • Appointment Setting • Sales • Negotiation • Cold Calling • Customer Service • Real Estate Wholesaling • Deal Sourcing • Google Sheets • Excel • CRM Systems • ChatGPT • AI Tools



You do NOT need experience with everything.



We would rather hire someone intelligent, hungry, resourceful, and coachable than someone with a perfect résumé and no drive.



CAREER GROWTH



We are initially hiring TWO people.



As the operation grows, responsibilities may expand into areas such as:



Deal Acquisition



Marketplace Sales



High-Ticket Deal Research



Negotiation



Team Leadership



Training



Quality Control



Operations Management



Our goal is to identify people early who can eventually help RUN parts of this business instead of simply working inside it.



IMPORTANT: DO NOT APPLY THROUGH THIS POSTING LIKE EVERYONE ELSE



We intentionally created a specific application process.



If you read this entire job posting, follow the instructions below EXACTLY.



Generic applications will not receive a response.



Do not send a long cover letter.



Do not send us an AI-generated essay explaining why you are hardworking.



We want to see whether you can follow instructions.



STEP 1 —
 APPLICATION



Send an
 directly to:







Your
 subject line MUST be:



FLIP TEAM 2026 — [YOUR FIRST NAME]



Example:



FLIP TEAM 2026 — Maria



Do not change the words FLIP TEAM 2026.



Our system uses this exact phrase to trigger the next stage of the application process.



If you follow the instructions correctly, you will receive the Stage 1 Applicant Assessment.



Complete Stage 1 carefully.



Only the strongest Stage 1 applicants will be invited to Stage 2.



Stage 2 will be significantly more difficult and will test whether you can actually identify, research, evaluate, and think through real opportunities.



We are not looking for the most applicants.



WE ARE LOOKING FOR TWO SUPERSTARS.

title: Roofing Lead Setter
description:
Lead Qualifier / Phone Setter — Roofing (Full-Time, Remote)



Booked generates exclusive homeowner leads for roofing contractors across the US.



The Role



Homeowners reply to our SMS campaigns. You call them, qualify them, and confirm they want a roofer to reach out. You are not booking calendar appointments — you are qualifying leads and setting them up for handoff.



This is a calling-heavy job: 100–150 dials a day, most of them follow-ups on people who already replied to us. No cold calling from purchased lists — everyone you call raised their hand first.



What You'll Do



Call new SMS replies within minutes — speed to lead d
 most of it

Qualify: do they own the home, is the roof 15+ years old, is there damage or a leak, are they actually interested

Confirm they're expecting the roofer's call, and note the best time to reach them

Follow up relentlessly — most leads convert on attempt 3 through 7, not attempt 1

Log every call outcome in Airtable, accurately



Requirements

Near-native, neutral English on the phone. You'll be talking to American homeowners, many of them 50+. They need to understand you instantly. This is the number one requirement and we screen hard for it.

1+ year of outbound calling, phone sales, or customer service — US market preferred. Roofing, solar, or home services is a plus.

Thick skin and persistence. You will get hung up on.

Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet room with a door that closes, a real headset, and a backup power/internet plan.

Able to commit to a genuine 60-hour week.



Schedule

60 hours per week, six days, roughly 10 hours a day, on your assigned US market's time zone (we run markets from Florida to Oregon). Read that twice before applying — the hours are the job.



Pay

Base of about $1,300 USD/month at full hours, plus uncapped per-lead bonuses. Realistic total: $2,000–$3,500/month, depending entirely on how many qualified leads you produce. Paid biweekly.



The top of that range is real, not a headline number — our strongest setters earn most of their pay from bonus, not base.



How to Apply



Subject line must read exactly: ROOF-SETTER — [your city] — [your daily dial volume]



Include: your calling experience, your available hours in US Eastern Time, and a speedtest.net screenshot.



Please send a short video assignment the same day — about 4 minutes, phone camera, one take, no editing. You'll answer three questions about your last sales or customer service job:



1. What were your actual numbers — calls per day, and how many sales or leads did that produce? And how did you know those numbers, where did you see them?

2. What was the worst call you ever had there? What did the customer say, what did you say, and what would you do differently now?

3. Why did you leave? If we called your last supervisor today, what one thing would they say you needed to improve?



The video is not optional — please only apply if you're willing to record one.

title: SEO & AI Visibility Account manager
description:
# SEO & AI Visibility Client Success Manager



## About SaaSLaunch



SaaSLaunch helps SaaS companies grow through predictable acquisition systems, AI-powered search visibility, and high-performing digital infrastructure.



We're looking for an **SEO & AI Visibility Client Success Manager** to take ownership of client communication and oversee the execution of our SEO, AEO, and GEO services.



This is **not a traditional SEO specialist role where you'll spend your entire day writing articles or manually doing SEO work.**



You'll be responsible for making sure our clients get results.



You'll communicate directly with clients, coordinate with our developers, QA website and landing page work, identify opportunities, and make sure everything that needs to get done actually gets done.



You'll also use our internal software and systems to manage blogs, articles, artifacts, website scans, AI visibility analysis, and other SEO/AEO/GEO initiatives.



## About the Role



You'll own a portfolio of SaaS clients and act as the bridge between the client and our execution team.



A typical day might include reviewing a client's website, identifying pages that should be created or improved, assigning changes to our developer, QA'ing completed work, making small website or Google Business Profile updates, reviewing visibility data, and communicating progress to the client.



We're looking for someone who takes initiative.



If you notice a client needs a new page, you shouldn't wait for someone to tell you to create it. You should identify the opportunity, coordinate with the developer, QA the finished work, and make sure it gets launched.



Our systems handle much of the heavy lifting. Your job is to **manage, oversee, QA, communicate, and continuously look for ways to improve client results.**



## Responsibilities



* Own day-to-day communication with assigned clients

* Build strong client relationships and keep clients informed on progress

* Oversee SEO, AEO, and GEO execution across client accounts

* Review client websites and identify opportunities for improvement

* Coordinate website and landing page changes with our developer

* Request new pages when opportunities are identified

* QA landing pages, website changes, content, and other deliverables before they go live

* Optimize existing website pages when needed

* Make smaller website and Google Business Profile updates

* Use our internal software to manage blogs, articles, artifacts, scans, analysis, and AI visibility initiatives

* Review SEO and AI visibility performance and determine what should happen next

* Identify problems or opportunities before the client has to point them out

* Keep developers and other team members accountable for completing client work

* Ensure client accounts continue moving forward without requiring founder involvement



## You're a Strong Fit If You



* Have experience with SEO, AEO, GEO, website management, or digital marketing

* Understand the fundamentals of on-page and technical SEO

* Are comfortable working with websites, landing pages, Google Search Console, and Google Business Profile

* Can review a landing page or website and identify obvious problems or opportunities

* Are comfortable communicating directly with clients

* Can translate technical work into simple updates clients understand

* Have experience coordinating developers, designers, writers, or other specialists

* Take initiative instead of waiting to be given every task

* Follow up relentlessly when something needs to get completed

* Are comfortable learning new AI and SEO software quickly

* Care about client results and retention, not simply completing a checklist



Experience working with SaaS or B2B companies is a major plus.



## What Success Looks Like



**Client Success:** Clients are happy, informed, seeing progress, and getting measurable results.



**Ownership:** Accounts move forward without the founders needing to manage day-to-day execution.



**Execution:** Website changes, new pages, optimizations, and deliverables are completed quickly and correctly.



**Quality:** Work is properly reviewed and QA'd before reaching the client or going live.



**Initiative:** You're constantly identifying the next opportunity to improve a client's SEO, AEO, and GEO performance.



## How to Apply



Apply here:





Please include:

We're looking for someone who takes ownership. If something can improve a client's results, we want someone who identifies it, gets it implemented, verifies it was done correctly, and communicates the progress to the client.

HOURS

Initially: 15–25 hours per week, spread across Monday–Saturday with daily availability required.

Strong potential to grow to around 40 hours per week across Monday–Saturday.

You must be available 6 days per week; this is not a role where hours can be condensed into fewer days.



WHAT WE NEED

You must be:



* Extremely detail-oriented, organised and reliable

* Strong in written English

* Comfortable following detailed processes and checklists

* Proactive with follow-ups and able to keep track of multiple tasks

* Careful about recording actions and keeping accurate records

* Confident using systems and handling detailed administrative work



Previous UK lettings/property management experience is preferred.

If you do not have direct lettings experience, we would expect relevant experience in a legal, compliance, conveyancing, property or similarly regulated administrative environment, where accuracy, process and judgement are important.





HOW TO APPLY:

Provide response to the following:

Task  1 – Right to Rent & Move-In:



Lucy and Sue have applied jointly for a property in England, with the tenancy due to start on 1 September.

Sue has successfully completed referencing, including her Right to Rent check.

Lucy has completed all other referencing requirements, but her Right to Rent check is still outstanding. She currently lives in Canada and is due to move to the UK on 24 August.

There is a possibility that Lucy may not be able to complete her Right to Rent check before the tenancy start date.

They ask:

“If Lucy’s Right to Rent is not completed by 1 September, can we both still move in? If not, can Sue move in first and Lucy join once her Right to Rent is completed?”

How would you handle this situation?



Please:

• identify any issues or risks you think need to be considered

• explain what you would check before giving them an answer

• outline the possible options

• recommend how you think the agency should proceed

• draft the response you would send to Lucy and Sue



What we are assessing

We are not looking for a perfect answer.

We want to see how you approach a real lettings situation, what you notice, what you would investigate, and how you work towards a practical and compliant solution.

If you are unsure about something, explain what you would check or who you would escalate it to rather than making an assumption.

Please take enough time to properly think through the scenario.







Q1. How would you rate your experience in UK lettings?

**0** – No UK lettings experience

**1** – Limited exposure / basic understanding

**2** – Some practical experience with lettings administration

**3** – Good working experience across the tenancy process

Q2. How comfortable are you using Excel / Google Sheets, Outlook /
, WhatsApp, Calendly and other CRM/property management software as part of your daily work?

1 – Basic experience and may need regular guidance

2 – Comfortable with everyday tasks

3 – Confident using these tools independently

4 – Very confident, quick to learn new systems and comfortable managing work across multiple platforms



Q3. How would you rate your Goodlord experience?**

**0** – Never used it

**1** – Some experience / basic familiarity

**2** – Confident using it for day-to-day lettings administration

**3** – Very experienced / strong working knowledge



**Q4.** Are you available to work Monday–Saturday during UK working hours, starting at approximately 15–25 hours per week and increasing to around 40 hours across 6 days with time? Please mention any regular commitments that may affect your availability.



THANK YOU!
